This arrangement is based on the "Sonata in D Minor, W. 64/24" for keyboard composed by Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach in the mid-18th century. An excellent work for introducing young musicians to the innovations of C.P.E. Bach's music.

Courtly pageantry, simple beauty and rambunctious fun abound in this wonderful setting! A delightful suite of “Mr. Purcell”s Riggadoon.” “Over the Hills and Far Away,” and “Lazy Pirate’s Jig.” Music to delight the king, the commoner and everyone else!
Energy, excitement and drama abound is this powerful, driving masterwork. A joyful showpiece!
A delightful romp through bygone British music halls and salons. A rare old one-step artfully arranged. Lots of fun!

Berlioz's “Grande Symphonie Funebre et Triomphale” (for 200 winds and percussion,) scored for concert band. Brilliant brass fanfares, big noble melodies and antiphonal percussion make this piece the high point of any performance. A Perfect choice for festival or honor band finale.

Like all of Deiro's overtures, "Trieste" is in the style of Rossini's operatic overtures. A forceful, dramatic opening is followed by a warm bel canto melody then bounds into a series of opera buffa melodies, with dazzling bravura parts for everyone, even a rousing basso profundo for the bottom of the band. A brand-new festive melody, a breathtaking coda, and a dramatic maestoso restatement of the opening theme bring
This high-stepping quickstep will bring smiles to your audience. Everyone will enjoy this lively tune that was all the rage, on both sides of the Atlantic, in 1911. Great fun!

Teaching 6/8 rhythm has never been so much fun with one of the most familiar TV theme songs of all time! This little march will delight your band and bring a big smile to your audience as you take them back to Mayfield—to Ward and June, Wally and Beaver, Eddie, Lumpy, Whitey and Larry. Pure fun!
An exciting showpiece for band! Great opener—or closer—for your next concert. Lots of color and excitement. Grand proclamations from many sections in this great work!
Written in the style of a U. S. Civil War marching song, this captivating little march features the historic flag-raising bugle call, “To the Colors.” Delightful!

All the drama, excitement and color that we expect from this gifted composer predicated on non-harmonic passing tones. This advancing-changing-evolving piece recalls a quote from Marcus Aurelius: “Time is a sort of river of passing events, and strong is its current.” Stunning!

One of the most popular, and the noisiest, of all of Strauss’ dance pieces. “Unter Donner und Blitz” evokes the sound of thunder and lightning through incessant timpani rolls, cymbal clashes and bass drum thunder claps. This sparkling new arrangement is sure to prompt—what else—thunderous applause!

There is a lot of variety and contrast compressed into this work for young band. Instrumental colors suggest moods from declamatory to foreboding to playful; textures range from sostenuto to staccato. An excellent opportunity to invite your students to invent story lines or scenarios to be shared with your audience.
Featuring "Blackamwore by the Stour", "The Winter's Willow," and "Boy Johnny."
A fine old Italian-American March, in the style of a tarantella. Bright, breezy, and a lot of fun!

Festive brass fanfares announce this magnificent combination of Beethoven’s “Ode to Joy” with the famous carol, “O Come All Ye Faithful.” Nobility abounds in this fantasy on two famous beloved melodies. Sure to be a holiday favorite!
sous_titre: Ode To Joy - O Come All Ye Faithful

description: A unique arrangement combining the very gentle song with a boisterous dance. This setting has several sections:  -Introduction  -Suogan Theme with variations  -Percussion Transition  -Original Jig theme with variations  -The Jig and Suogan themes together  -Coda Interesting and delightful for everyone!
Achievement is a chorale and march using the first 7 notes found in most beginning band methods.
Name That Christmas Carol, which uses only 6 notes from concert Bb to G, is designed to be an audience participation game that will add some fun to your first Christmas concert.

The beginning tempo marking says it all for this exciting piece: “With energy and determination.” The strength of Zephyrus and the rhythm of his “Z” (Morse Code rhythm: long-long-short-short) are the foundation of this bold, dramatic work for young band.

A musical depiction of two Arkansas towns devastated by a tornado. The story is told, moving from quietness to havoc, and incorporating the beautiful old hymn, “What Wondrous Love Is This.” A grand synthesis of beauty, drama and the aleatoric. Memorable!

A musical fantasy depicting the wide range of the wind’s character that occurs throughout the year. Opening with a gentle breeze followed by clouds, thunder, lightning and rain. From beautiful little melodies of the lonesome prairie to big, brash percussive storm sounds; there are a lot of opportunities to study contrast. Brilliant and accessible!

“Whispering,” first made popular by Whiteman, and later, by Goodman and Dorsey, is the basis for this fun-filled arrangement. This band-friendly, kid-friendly piece will ‘fox-trot’ your young players back to America’s big band era. Entertaining!
Poignant and hauntingly beautiful. This lyrical piece is a touching memorial to help heal and remember. Breathtaking.

This is a perfect study for expressive playing with young bands. A chance for all instruments to show their warmth and beauty. Based on “Gwenith Gwyn,” a bittersweet eighteenth century Welsh folksong. Beautiful and illuminating!
titre: While I Watch The Yellow Wheat

description: Exquisite melodies soar throughout this touching masterwork for winds! Beautiful music brilliantly scored! Breathtaking.

The sounds of the Old West come alive! This work portrays the lives of the pioneers who sought to find a better way of life for their families and those who would follow them. Full of style, energy, beauty, and character! Very enjoyable!

A Stirring, Noble march in the traditional regimental style. Commissioned by the United States Military Academy Band. Dedicated to the Academy’s motto, “Duty, Honor, Country”, and to West Point’s two hundred years of patriotic service. Very inspirational!

Based on an old Highland dance tune, "Carron's Reel," also known as "Gentry Libby." The dance tune and an original tune are played over a bagpipe effect with regimental drums, first approaching, and then passing into the distace. Wonderful!
From the courtly trumpet fanfare to the big stately Trio, this march says nobility! Imperial themes and impressive countermelodies abound! Gorgeous horn parts. Thrilling and very attractive!

Christmas Stomp is a perfect composition for a beginning band’s Christmas Concert. It features three percussion soloists that play on different sounding buckets. The piece is written in a swing style, which will make it more enjoyable to play.

The Johannes Brahms Symphony No. 1 Theme is designed to give your best players an opportunity to play a solo with band accompaniment. This solo is the same one that appears on page 36, book 1 of The Yamaha Advantage® for oboe, bassoon, alto clarinet, tenor saxophone and horn. This arrangement also includes solo parts for Flute, Clarinet and Alto Saxophone. This piece can also be performed by band alone.

Elite March is written to introduce the march form and style to young musicians. Playing marches is part of the heritage of the band and is an importance style that students should learn to play. The form of this composition includes the traditional modulation to the subdominant at the Trio.

Snarendipity features solo snare drum with band. This piece can be performed by one snare drummer or with multiple snare drum soloists. The snare drum part includes contemporary sounds as well as many rudiments.
Legends is designed to reinforce eighth-note patterns and 3/4 time. The composition is a perfect contest/festival style piece and as the title implies, is reminiscent of swashbuckling heroes.

Rock America opens with a full band lyrical statement of America the Beautiful leading to a restatement of America the Beautiful in a hip new style reminiscent of the great Ray Charles version. The arrangement includes You’re a Grand Old Flag, which has elements of the rock feel, interspersed with a traditional march style.

Christmas Gloria begins with a snare drum solo snares off which sets the tone for a bolero style arrangement reminiscent of the Little Drummer Boy but based on the all time favorite Pat-a-Pan. The arrangement builds to a climax that brings in the melody of the Gloria section of Angles We Have Heard On High.
Honor March is written to introduce the March form and style to young musicians. Playing marches is part of the heritage of the band and is an importance style that the students should learn to play.

The Ash Grove is designed to give your best trumpet, trombone, baritone or tuba player an opportunity to play a solo with band accompaniment. It should serve as the culmination of study for the soloist at the completion of any method book 1. The piece also has all of the solo material cued in the band so if a soloist is not available you can perform this piece with band alone.

Christmas Surprise is a perfect composition for your first Christmas Concert. It only uses the first 7 notes introduced in most beginning band methods; concert Bb to G plus the low A. This arrangement uniquely combines Jingle Bells and Jolly Old Saint Nicholas with Haydn’s Surprise Symphony. It also includes a unique section where the band sings.
Sentinel is designed to reinforce the key of Eb after the note concert Ab is learned. It contains contemporary harmonies, tuneful melodies and exciting percussion.

Christmas Toyland is a clever new arrangement that combines the famous march from the Tchaikovsky Nutcracker with the Victor Herbert classic Toyland. It is perfect to reinforce triplets and 3/4 time. The combination of these two wonderful compositions is certain to be an audience favorite.

Outback Rhapsody introduces the delightful music of Australia in a contest style piece. It is perfect to reinforce 6/8 time in 2. It combines 3 popular folk songs from Australia and would be great to use in a multicultural presentation.

Antiphony is a serious composition that will highlight your budding percussionists. This bold and harmonically progressive piece has an extensive percussion section that is placed antiphonally around the band to give the piece a stereophonic effect.

Four very attractive French songs combined to make a great work for concert or festival. While each tune is strong enough to stand alone, they each have interesting stories that make them wonderful teaching material. Memorable music from long ago!  Movements: 1. The Duke of Marlborough Goes to War 2. Chanson Triste (Une Jeune Fillette) 3. Bon Voyage, Monsieur Dumollet 4. Petit Papa
Energy, excitement and drama abound is this powerful, driving masterwork. A joyful showpiece!
Here's an easy and tuneful blues number that you'll enjoy programming year after year! Expertly scored for beginning bands, this piece gives you the opportunity to teach the concept of "swing."
Powerful melodic lines and an interesting modal flavor are features of this exciting march. An ideal choice for that important first concert.
The relaxed spirit of the islands is captured in this colorful number which effectively features your entire flute section.
Strong melodic lines accompanied by short quarter notes will have your band sounding their best in no time! Perfect for that first performance.
Yep, you guessed it! "Three Blind Mice" entertainingly arranged in a dynamic rock style. Expertly scored for bands just starting out.
Here's a fantastic march that's perfect for first year bands. All sections of the band get a chance with the melody.

This concert march is solidly scored and incorporates the "call and response" compositional technique similar to that used by composers in the Baroque period. All sections of the band get a chance to play the melody. Ideal for that important first performance.
Young players will really enjoy this tuneful calypso. Easy repetitive rhythms make it a breeze to perform.

A fun and creative composition designed to reinforce 6/8 compound meter. Interesting harmonies and an eerie mood will pique the interest and imaginations of your students and audiences alike. A very enjoyable musical experience to enhance the musicianship of your students!
titre: A Ride Through The Haunted Mansion

description: The essence of improving the aural skills of your students is by teaching them to recognize melodic intervals as part of the structure of music. This contest/festival style piece is also designed to teach most of the major and minor melodic intervals through the two main themes of the piece. As an added bonus, the back page of the parts includes both of the melodies written out for all of the instruments so that you

A true "contest" style piece for the beginning band that uses limited note and rhythm resources, but is very creatively written. Your youngest students will feel like they are playing serious music, as the piece is bold, aggressive and sounds more difficult than it plays. This is the type of exceptional music you have come to expect from two of the most popular composers of beginning band music. This piece is
Shaker Settings is a combination of two shaker songs Father James’s Song and the famous Simple Gifts. This is a very playable and effective arrangement for contest use.

Equinox is a tour-de-force for the young band and can serve as the culmination of study at the end of The Yamaha Advantage Band Method book 2 or any band method book 2. It is a contest piece with driving rhythms, bold fanfare gestures, lyrical lines and climatic moments that will help to show off your band to their best abilities.

Genesis is a contest style piece that can be used as the culmination of study at the end of The Yamaha Advantage or at the end of any band method book 1. This popular performance piece from the back of book 1 has been requested by directors to be available separately so that they can perform the piece at contest. It is a real winner!
This stately, evocative arrangement is based upon an ancient Native American hymn. A very effective choice for your next program.
Revive the "Spirit of '76" with this driving and dramatic march by Ralph Gingery. Excellent!
Jay Chattaway's stirring and beautiful work was written as a tribute to a young musician. It's a perfect piece for developing bands!
This lively Latin-flavored original captures both the spirit and excitement of the islands. A high-energy piece that is lots of fun to perform. It will be a winner with the audience as well!

Jeff Taylor has taken the ever-popular Irving Berlin standard and given it a most creative treatment including a swing-march, dixieland style, 6/8 march, and driving big-band swing. You really can't miss with this fine arrangement!
A unique way to feature a drum set soloist with the concert band. This Jay Chattaway original, with its straight ahead jazz feel, will be a program favorite!

This dynamic piece starts with a marcato, strongly rhythmic character with lots of fine percussion writing. The contrasting middle section features tuneful themes with several meter changes for added interest.

Bob James' masterful adaptation of Bizet's dance suite features fiery rhythms and exquisite colors in a superb contemporary setting. This energetic arrangement is certain to be a favorite on any program.
Here's a pop-styled piece designed to spotlight your entire flute section. Several effective and contrasting moods are presented in this delightful original.
Once you've heard this electrifying journey into the day's pop and rock sounds, you'll definitely want it to highlight your next program!
All the excitement and sophistication of the Bob James recording has been captured in this outstanding arrangement.
This contemporary pop-styled ballad spotlights a flugelhorn (trumpet) soloist and will round out your concert program beautifully.

This excellent overture was written for the TCU Wind Ensemble. Heroic in character, the piece masterfully exploits the variety of colors available to the modern wind ensemble through interesting solis and solos. This piece is tonal in nature and contains many original and identifiable themes.

A dramatic arrangement of favorite Christmas themes in the masterful Jay Chattaway style.  Featuring "What Child Is This?" and a jazzy feeling contempory setting of "Jingle Bells."  You'll enjoy performing this brilliant showpiece for many years to come!

From its ceremonial introduction to its powerful conclusion, the masterful thematic delineation and development of "Ritual Celebration" are central to this major work for symphonic band.  Based upon the Kyrie from the Gregorian Mass "In Festis Duplicibus."

A powerful one-movement composition based upon several musical motives that are skillfully developed into a piece that explores many of the varied tonal and rhythmic resources of today's wind ensemble. Great for contest or concert use!
Achievement is a chorale and march using the first 7 notes found in most beginning band methods.

Christmas Stomp is a perfect composition for a beginning band’s Christmas Concert. It features three percussion soloists that play on different sounding buckets. The piece is written in a swing style, which will make it more enjoyable to play.
The seasonal favorite "O, Tannenbaum" effectively presented in a series of jazzy variations. A sure-fire crowd pleaser!
A remarkably fine choice for contest use. This overture features dramatic, contrasting themes with real musical impact.
Here's a rock chart with a powerful and very contemporary feel. Guaranteed to be a major hit on any program!
This outstanding trumpet duet has a distinctive Spanish flavor. The lively, rhythmic theme is contrasted by a lyrical middle section. An excellent feature for your top trumpet players.

Although technically within the range of most intermediate bands, City Of Champions sounds incredibly mature! Contrasting moods, skillful interplay of themes and lots of bold ensemble power make it a clear winner!
This enchanting lyrical composition spotlights your alto saxophone soloist. Note the very effective cadenza section.
POWER DRIVE captures the spirit of today's popular music. All section of the band have interesting parts in this exciting and very enjoyable selection.
SEASCAPE is a wonderful tone poem for band which describes the serenity and beauty of a coastal scene. Very effective!

Owen Glendower led a Welsh uprising against England in the 16th century. Though his quest for independence was unsuccessful, he is none-the-less regarded as a national hero. The overture's heroic and dramatic nature makes it an outstanding choice for any program.
This brilliant concert march has it all: powerful themes, effective counterlines, dramatic contrasts and plenty of good solid scoring. Very effective!

Here's a great arrangement of a lively folk song from the "outback" by one of Australia's leading composer-arrangers. Right down to the hand clapping and foot stomping, your band and audiences will love this energetic piece!

Jay Chattaway's unique talent for writing music that makes young players sound mature is most evident in this fine composition. The tuneful, British character make this a natural choice for exciting programming.
This composition lets you feature one of your often "unsung" players in lyrical and animated styles. The solo part may be played by baritone, trombone, tenor sax or bassoon. Superb!

George M. Cohan's patriotic standard has long been a crowd favorite and it's made even more exciting in this skillful and inventive arrangement! All sections of the band have interesting parts in this very enjoyable and lively selection.

The Johannes Brahms Symphony No. 1 Theme is designed to give your best players an opportunity to play a solo with band accompaniment. This solo is the same one that appears on page 36, book 1 of The Yamaha Advantage® for oboe, bassoon, alto clarinet, tenor saxophone and horn. This arrangement also includes solo parts for Flute, Clarinet and Alto Saxophone. This piece can also be performed by band alone.
Here's an easy and tuneful blues number that you'll enjoy programming year after year! Expertly scored for beginning bands, this piece gives you the opportunity to teach the concept of "swing."

This celebrated Ukrainian carol ("Carol of the Bells") has been a favorite for generations! All of its excitement and vitality is expertly presented in Jeff Taylor's colorful and imaginative arrangement.

This processional march will be a perfect addition on many different programs. Solidly scored for younger players, it's characterized by a strong, tuneful melody and bold rhythms. Following a dramatic modulation, this stirring march leads to a glorious finale!

This delightful composition can be played either as a section feature, a duet or as a solo. Right down to the solo cadenza, CLARINETICS provides just the right amount of challenge and interest for your players.

Written as the finale to Jay's Western Suite. "JAMBOREE" works equally well as an individual selection. It is characterized by bold syncopated rhythms and strong melodic theme, reminiscent of some of the great Western movie scores.
A light rock ballad that's very playable yet with a surprising degree of sophistication and appeal. Can be effectively programmed as the second part of the Western Suite.
The rhythmic vitality and powerful melodies of this brilliant piece make it ideal as an individual number or combined with "Sunride" and/or "Jamboree" as part of Jay's Western Suite.
This sparkling composition features your entire flute section. Imaginatively scored in an appealing light rock style.

Great opener on any of your concert programs. Bright, bold harmonies and a strong, tuneful melody arranged so all sections of the band have interesting parts. Don't miss this colorfully and tuneful march!
Add the excitement of Spain to your next concert with this exciting composition. Plenty of audience appeal. Ole!
A delightful combination of the enchanting "Lavender Blue" and the stirring "Loch Lomond" in a lyrical arrangement that's interesting for all sections.
titre: Two Songs From the British Isles

description: This energetic disco-rock excursion will be a "sure-fire" success with both audience and band. Guaranteed!

Written to commemorate the release of the American hostages from their long imprisonment in Iran, this dynamic composition is characterized by powerful rhythms and bold harmonies. Mature sounding yet well within the technical limits of young players.
A haunting melody and lush harmonies combine in this exciting beguine that's extremely effective for young players.
Highly imaginative disco treatment of Yankee Doodle that's sure to be a hit with both your band and your audience!
Powerful melodic lines and an interesting modal flavor are features of this exciting march. An ideal choice for that important first concert.
Revive the "Spirit of '76" with this driving and dramatic march by Ralph Gingery. Excellent!

Two movements make up this outstanding composition. The first features lyrical flute and clarinet solo passages while the second movement contrasts with a faster tempo, strong themes and powerful ensemble sections. A great addition to the contest literature available at this level!
This bold march is loaded with power and drive! Makes a great addition to any of your programs, especially as a dramatic opener.

Here's something totally different! It's a musical adventure into thematic contrast and development which features the musical triumph of the "good guys" over some rather unsavory characters. Cleverly conceived and skillfully written for younger bands, it's sure to be a real favorite!

The exciting sounds of a Brazilian street festival complete with all the drums and whistles in a very easy arrangement for young bands. A great spotlight for the percussion section while not overly challenging the winds.

Here's a bold Spanish-flavored composition which features your trumpet soloist. Both an easy and more difficult version of the solo part are included. Powerfully scored for maximum sound, it's perfect for developing bands!

Your players will really "get-into" this rock number which reflects the break-dancing craze. It's easy to play and even includes some vocals from the band. Sure to score high with your performers and audience on any of your programs!

Revive the spirit of old New Orleans with this exciting arrangement which features a swing treatment of "Just A Closer Walk With Thee" and an easy, rousing arrangement of the perennial favorite, "When The Saints Go Marchin' In." You can't miss with this crowd-pleaser!

This outstanding arrangement opens dramatically with "When Johnny Comes Marching Home" then moves to a majestic treatment of "America, the Beautiful" before concluding with an easy yet very effective "Star Spangled Banner."
Interesting percussion colors highlight this lively and fun-to-play samba that fits the skills of first and second year players just right.
A brilliant contemporary overture by Jeff Taylor. Note how the forceful main theme contrasts perfectly with a lyrical middle section. All sections of the band have interesting parts.
This majestic and dynamic overture will be quickly learned and enjoyed by young performers. A very easy yet extremely effective selection.
This is guaranteed to be a winner with your players and audience! Authentic rock rhythms have been skillfully incorporated into a driving and energetic number that's perfect for young band.

This majestic arrangement of the traditional carol makes use of the theme and variations form. Each section of the band has an opportunity to play the melody in this imaginative and effective selection. Perfect for your holiday program!
Give your young group a chance to really "swing" with this fun concert-styled blues. A delightful change-of-pace selection that will be thoroughly enjoyed by band and audiences alike!
Jay Chattaway's stirring and beautiful work was written as a tribute to a young musician. It's a perfect piece for developing bands!
You can feature either an alto sax or trumpet soloist with this enchanting, pop-styled ballad. Your band will really enjoy performing it!
Here's a highly inventive treatment of this fine Christmas carol. It will certainly be an important addition to your holiday program.
This fine march-styled composition was written by one of the best composers of concert band literature. Use it to open or conclude any of your programs with real style!
Here's a superb and especially effective composition by Jeffrey Taylor. This brilliant concert work is powerful yet very playable.
Looking for a special piece to feature your trumpet section? This outstanding selection works incredibly well with young bands!
Here's an excellent overture which features contrasting tempos and solid scoring. You'll find it perfect for both festival and concert performances.
This is the concluding movement to Jay's Second Suite for Band. "Ceremony" also works great as an individual selection characterized by expressive lines and exciting powerful rhythms.
Powerful dynamic effects and dramatic sweeping melodic lines characterize this bold composition. Great as a individual selection or as the second movement of Jay's Second Suite for Band.
Imagine opening your next concert with this dramatic composition! Can be effectively programmed as the first movement of the Second Suite for Band.

This sparkling Christmas medley features well-known carols from England, France, and Germany. Although the principal songs featured are "Deck the Halls," "Lo How A Rose E'er Blooming," and "Bring a Torch Jeanette Isabella," the transitions utilize tuneful quotations of other carols associated with each country. Carefully and thoughtfully arranged for young bands!
This fresh contemporary ballad offers you the unique opportunity to feature your choice of soloists. Parts are included for solo trumpet, solo flute, solo clarinet and solo alto sax.
An outstanding rock-flavored original that will be an instant favorite with your band! They'll really come to life with this one!
This exceptionally fine band composition musically depicts a space voyage to a distant galaxy and its triumphant return to earth. Destined to become a favorite!
Jeff Taylor has written one of the best marches in the entire First Concert Series. It's easy yet very impressive in performance.
Here's a great way to introduce your band to music by Prokofiev. This whimsical march has been very skillfully adapted for band by Ralph Gingery.
The seasonal favorite "O, Tannenbaum" effectively presented in a series of jazzy variations. A sure-fire crowd pleaser!
A brilliant, stately march characterized by a strong, tuneful melody and bold rhythms. Don't pass this one up!
It takes just the right elements to make a great rock style work for young band. This one's got them all!
A perfect way to feature your entire sax section (altos and tenors.) This Latin-flavored original is a delight to play and to program.

In the tradition of his highly successful BRAVADA, Jerry's latest concert/ contest composition will have your players sounding mature beyond their years. Strong themes, powerful rhythms and a beautiful lyrical section.

Here's a medley of two interesting and very popular folk songs from the Soviet Union ("Stenka Razin" and "Varshavyanka.") Bring the spirit of Glastnost right into your band room with this delightful programming choice.
This stately processional march features contrasting instrumental colors from all the various band sections. Highly effective!
This favorite carol is given a colorful and creative treatment by Ralph Gingery. A very refreshing and easy-to-learn arrangement!
Here's a fun piece that features your entire flute section. This delightful ragtime number is sure to become a favorite for players as well as audiences!
This stately march begins with an accented fanfare statement which leads to a very heroic style. Note the contrasting warm, legato trio-like theme. Excellent writing for younger bands!
Contemporary rock rhythms are combined with very playable wind parts to make a most enjoyable musical experience for the developing band.
This lively, colorful selection will add variety to any program. Solidly scored for young bands, its Latin flavor appeals to both players and audiences.
This excellent overture was written to evoke the majestic aura of the monuments and memorials in our Nation's Capitol. It will be an outstanding choice for contest or concert programming.
This lyrical rock ballad is an outstanding feature for a young trumpet soloist. A very effective and interesting program addition!

The official march of the U.S. Navy has been expertly arranged for young bands by Jay Chattaway, the former chief arranger with the Navy Band in Washington, D.C. Includes the dramatic "Eternal Father."

Featuring the same well-known folk song used by John Barnes Chance's in his Variations on a Korean Folk Song, here's a delightful piece that introduces some fascinating new sounds and textures to younger bands.

This celebrated Ukrainian carol ("Carol of the Bells") has been a favorite for generations! All of its excitement and vitality is expertly presented in Jeff Taylor's colorful and imaginative arrangement.
What a delightful way to feature your entire flute section. The lively ragtime rhythms and easy accompaniment are sure to make this an interesting and fun addition to your program.
Brilliantly written to present your band at its best, this dramatic and exuberant composition is a perfect choice for concert and contest programming.
All the charm and warmth of this well-known traditional English carol is perfectly captured in this outstanding and imaginative arrangement.

The "Prelude" creates a dramatic yet lyrical mood and is characterized by the use of interesting modern harmonies. The "Celebration" section, in contrast, features exciting and varied rhythms which propel the work to its logical conclusion. This outstanding and readily playable composition is a valuable addition to band literature.

George Frederick Handel (1685-1759) originally wrote this "Sarabande" as the third movement of his Suite No. 4 for harpsichord. Ralph Gingery expertly arranged this rich stately music (used as the theme in the film "Barry Lyndon") for successful performance by younger bands. However, the work also remains a rewarding and valuable piece for more mature ensembles.
A contemporary overture for band in the gospel-rock style by the well known and highly respected writer, Jerry Nowak. Guaranteed to please all!
A suite of three movements derived from ancient Irish or Gaelic melodies. ("The Miller's Dram," "Along The Ocean Shore," "The Blacksmith And His Son.") An excellent program piece.

Another exceptionally fine addition to concert band literature from Elliot Del Borgo. The driving energy of the opening is contrasted by a beautiful pensive middle section. The opening theme is then masterfully developed into a dynamic ending. Outstanding!
With memorable themes, striking harmonies and rhythmic vitality, this commanding overture is a noteworthy choice for contest or concert programming!
This fine original march would also make an wonderful processional! Its distinctive British character will be a highlight of your program.

This three-part overture is characterized by a vigorous main melody with a contrasting gentle, song-like middle section. Both the percussive and coloristic aspects of the symphonic band are masterfully utilized in this striking tone poem.
This tuneful and solidly scored march provides many opportunities for the band to explore various musical contrasts. Bright and energetic.

A fine addition to concert band literature from Jeffrey Taylor. "Festive Celebration" shows off the full range of your ensemble through contrasting themes, lively rhythms and refreshing harmonies. Excellent writing!

An excellent composition featuring contrapuntal textures and fresh modal lines. Great ensemble writing for all sections! Following a contrasting lyrical middle section, the main thematic elements are reintroduced and the piece leads to a powerful and impressive conclusion.

As the title implies, Quartal Sinfonia is structured on the interval of the perfect fourth. This important composition is comprised of three short, contrasting movements. Movement I is energetic and driving; Movement II is very sustained with tone clusters played in strong pesaute style; Movement III interweaves the themes and has a vigorus decisive closing.

Two movements make up this outstanding composition. The first features lyrical flute and clarinet solo passages while the second movement contrasts with a faster tempo, strong themes and powerful ensemble sections. A great addition to the contest literature available at this level!
You can feature either an alto sax or trumpet soloist with this enchanting, pop-styled ballad. Your band will really enjoy performing it!

Composed in 1881, during Sousa's tenure as leader of the United States Marine Band, this solid march was composed in honor of the 100th anniversary of the British surrender at Yorktown, Virginia, effectively ending the American Revolutionary War. This bright and stirring march from Sousa's early career is a "must" for Sousa enthusiasts.

This Sousa march gem from 1921 is now available in a handsome new edition by Sousa expert Keith Brion. This lively 6/8 march will have toes tapping, and it's delightful lilt will please audiences and performers alike. An excellent march for any performance occasion!

An authentic “John Philip Sousa, Inc” edition of the famous classic march created from Sousa’s own band parts by Keith Brion & Loras Schissel. Includes copious notes and performance suggestions including the various chime parts used by John Philip Sousa himself. A truly great march that should be in the repertoire of all good bands!

One of Sousa best marches made from Sousa’s original traveling band parts by noted Sousa experts Loras Schissel and Keith Brion. Includes copious program notes and performance suggestions that make this the “definitive” edition of this classic march favorite.

John Philip Sousa’s tasteful arrangement of this delightful Percy Grainger classic has been updated for modern concert band by Keith Brion and Loras Schissel. Includes copious rehearsal and performance notes and even some correspondence between Sousa and Grainger that gives insight into their thoughts about arrangements of Grainger’s music. Extremely nice!

One of Sousa’s most outstanding marches in a brand new edition created from the original Sousa Band’s traveling parts. Includes extensive program notes and performance suggestions and authorized by “John Philip Sousa, Inc., the Sousa family corporation.

John Philip Sousa's wonderful arrangement of the Grainger classic "Country Gardens" based on the actual Sousa Band parts and comes complete with correspondence between Sousa and Grainger discussing Sousa's arrangement. It has been carefully edited and articulated to assure performances.

One of Sousa's most popular marches, it is based on themes from his popular operetta of the same name. Big and bold and full of the sparkle that made Sousa the "March King". This historically accurate edition comes complete with helpful notes about the performance practices of the Sousa band. Outstanding in every respect!

One of Sousa's most popular and impressive marches, Sabre & Spurs is an outstanding Sousa march for mature bands. This historically accurate edition by Keith Brion & Loras Schissel comes complete with helpful notes about the performance practices of the Sousa band and other groups of that time period.

An outstanding Sousa march for mature bands. This historically accurate edition by Keith Brion & Loras Schissel comes complete with helpful notes about the performance practices of the Sousa band and other groups of that time period.
Brion & Schissel have created a marvelous edition from Sousa’s original parts and have included generous notes to help you produce outstanding performances of this great march classic!
Sousa scholars Keith Brion and Loras Schissel have created a historically authentic edition of one of the most popular marches from the Sousa Band library. THE edition of this Sousa classic.

One of Sousa’s most popular “songs” as a solo with band accompaniment. May be performed by any solo instrument (Cornet, Euphonium, Trombone solo parts are included) as well as a vocal solo part. Excellent material for adult bands as well as better high school and university bands. True Americana! Recently recorded on the CD “Stars and Stripes and Sousa!”.

Une partie lente dans un style ballade précède une reprise de l’ouverture qui s’achève sur une fin pétillante. Une œuvre idéale pour un concert ou un concours.

Le titre laisse supposer une vrai composition latino-américaine. Gyuri Spies a fait un mélange des mélodies excitantes de ce répertoire. Cet arrangement contient entre autres: Tico Tico, Espana Cani, El Cumbancero, Granada et Copacabana... Fiesta ! nous permet de vous présenter Gyuri Spies une première fois. Il est notamment actif dans le genre de la musique légère.

Cette œuvre a été écrite l’occasion du 50e anniversaire de l’académie de musique limbourgeoise de Neerpelt - Belgique. Elle décrit les premiers regards et expressions du visage des jeunes élèves lors de leur première rencontre. Une composition courte mais puissante qui peut aussi servir d’ouverture.

Aram Iljitsj Khatchaturian, de nationalité arménienne, naît en 1903 Tiflis, dans une famille pauvre de relieurs. Il débute sa formation musicale en 1922, la Gnessin Music School de Moscou, avec Mikhail Gnessis comme professeur de composition. Pour cette œuvre, le compositeur s’est inspiré de grandes ballades orchestrales d’artistes pop comme Marco Borsato, Céline Dion ou Laura Fabian, et l’a dédiée une personne spéciale. Gr ce l’instrumentation, "Ballata Per Te" peut ?tre joué par quasi n’importe quel orchestre et s’apparente surtout des mélodies entraînantes qui se succèdent tantôt en mineur, tantôt en majeur.
Ce tube mondial du groupe MUD datant de 1974 fut longtemps le morceau de Noël le plus joué de tous les temps. De la pure mélancolie. A entonner tous en choeur !

‘Sjaloom Chaverim’ : avec ce morceau traditionnel d’inspiration juive, vous donnerez votre concert de Noël une touche originale et universelle. Il est possible d’ajouter un choeur deux voix. Néanmoins, m?me sans choeur, cette oeuvre peut s’intégrer dans tout programme de Noël.

Ce morceau léger et haut en couleur est tout indiqué pour chauffer votre public.Comme son nom l’indique, ‘A Touch of Salsa’ n’est pas proprement parler un morceau de salsa même si le rythme de la salsa constitue le fondement même de cette composition pleine de fantaisie. Un en-cas musical léger pour mettre votre public au diapason du Sud. Convient pour les orchestres, comprend les redoublements nécessaires.

Le ‘Circus Picolini’ est l’un des derniers cirques flamands encore en activité en Belgique. Il est dirigé par la famille Hartmann. La particularité de ce cirque réside dans le fait que les représentations sont données non seulement sous tente, mais aussi dans des écoles, et que les enfants du public sont impliqués activement dans les différents numéros.Cette oeuvre se compose de trois parties ayant chacune un

Voici quelques années, Helmut Lotti a connu une célébrité immédiate avec ses imitations d’Elvis. Depuis lors, il mène une carrière internationale et a vendu des millions de disques. Il est sans doute le plus célèbre des artistes flamands ce jour. Filip Sandras a composé un medley de chansons extraites d’un de ces spectacles, en l’occurrence ‘La Adelita’, ‘Suspicious Minds’, ‘Sten’ka Rasin’ et ‘House of the Rising

Cette sélection de morceaux de gospel a été transposée par Willy Fransen dans une suite originale dont les parties s’entrem?lent. ‘Gospel Revival’ est le fruit de recherches laborieuses dans la très riche culture gospel.

Bavarian Pictures succède "A Bamberg Fantasy", mais est plus difficile et plus complexe. Dans cette oeuvre novatrice, le compositeur a voulu combiner des éléments traditionnels de tons avec des éléments d'avant-garde puisés dans le répertoire des concours. Cette composition est basée sur les lieder populaires de Bavière, qui se traduisent de diverses manières au travers de l'oeuvre.

Stef Minnebo est un compositeur et pédagogue passionné, un homme tourné vers les autres. Pleased to Meet You (Ravi de faire votre connaissance) résume parfaitement les qualités humaine de ce jeune compositeur. La trame est chaleureuse, simple et optimiste. Pleased to Meet You est une pièce idéale pour les Orchestres Juniors et pour toutes les formations géométrie variable.

Koen Pletinckx crée chaque fois la surprise avec ses compositions jeunes et rafraîchissantes pour orchestres dynamiques. Cette fois encore, il a glissé des éléments pop, de jolies mélodies et un rythme divin dans cette agréable composition intitulée « Poppy Times ». Ce morceau la portée de tous ravira coup s?r le public !

Ottorino Respighi (1879-1936) compte parmi les plus importants compositeurs italiens du XXe siècle. Ses oeuvres Pini di Roma, Feste Romane et Fontane di Roma sont surtout très connues et son style de composition plein de virtuosité stimule sans cesse notreimagination. Cette uvre a été composée la demande du Conservatoire Royal Flamand dAnvers et est dédié au fl?tiste Aldo Baerten. La première représentation a eu lieu le 15 mars 2006 dans la Blauwe Zaal du « deSingel » et a été interprétée par Aldo Baerten et lorchestre philharmonique du Conservatoire dAnvers.--Silver glow--Il fait nuit. « La Reine de la mer Adriatique » se baigne dans un éclat dargent sous un ciel de pleine lune.

Ekato, qui signifie 100 en grec, a été écrit la demande de la fanfare royale « De Strijders » dOosterwijk-Westerlo (Belgique) loccasion de leur centenaire en 2006. Cette œuvre intitulée „Jump!” est l’occasion de vous présenter pour la première fois le compositeur britannique David Gray. Cette composition pleine de fraîcheur est basée sur deux thèmes qui, soutenus par une section cadencée, sont mis en avant de manière de plus en plus entraînante. Idéal pour entrer dans le vif du sujet ou pour donner du rythme votre concert.

Dans cette ouverture festive, Menno Bosgra développe un thème écrit dans le style d’une fanfare, qui alterne avec une mélodie de choral majestueuse. Les deux thèmes sont orchestrés différemment et cheminent en alternance travers tous les pupitres de l’orchestre. Toutes les couleurs sonores sont ainsi révélées. Dans le passage final, les deux thèmes évoluent côte côte.  Majestic Solemnity  est une œuvre idéale

Suite au grand succès de „Remember the 70”, Filip Sandras nous propose cette excellente suite qui regroupe ces quelques titres inoubliables : „What’s another year”, mélodie rendue célèbre par le multiple gagnant du concours Eurovision de la chanson Johnny Logan, „Josephine” de Chris Rea, „Alive and Kicking” des Simple Minds et „Freedom”, du supergroupe des années 80 : Wham !

Au début des années 70, Reiner Lüghausen a composé cette marche inédite. Il lui a donné ce titre parce qu'il provient luimème de la vallée qui porte ce nom, en Allemagne. La source laquelle il puise une importante inspiration sont les marches américaines typiques dont vous ne manquerez pas de reconnaître les accents harmoniques.

Fabella a été écrit pour le compte de lHarmonie Royale Sint-Cecilia Kuringen, loccasion de ses 100 ans dexistence.La première a eu lieu lors du concert de jubilée le 17 mai 2008 au Hasseltse Schouwburg, sous la direction de Jos Cuppens.Cette composition fait le récit dune longue histoire musicale, et se plonge, par le biais dune série dimpressions, de souvenirs et de flashbacks, dans le riche passé de lHarmonie

description: Cette oeuvre concertante merveilleuse et très colorée fera briller votre orchestre de toutes ses facettes. Le début onirique est suivi d'un passage dansant qui devient de plus en plus animé et dans lequel tous les groupes ont tour tour voix au chapitre. Ensuite, le thème dramatique du début refait surface, avec un contre-chant superbe dans les cors/euphoniums, pour terminer enfin par une finale grandiose.

Cuba reste l'un des rares pays communistes au monde et peut se targuer d'une histoire turbulente, notamment due la présence du charismatique Fidel Castro, qui a emprunté une voie plus occidentale au cours des dernières années. Willy Fransen a écrit un récit de voyage musical sur le "pur sang" de la Havane avec des images d'ambiance teintes d’une couleur locale, et des plaisirs d’un daiquiri tout en écoutant un groupe

Clowns And Acrobats est idéal pour les orchestres jeunes et dynamiques. Après une introduction courte et mystérieuse, on poursuit avec un thème entraînant, qui est ensuite varié de plusieurs façons différentes. Cela se termine sur un paroxysme spectaculaire, mais qui n’est pas trop difficile d’un point de vue technique.

Club Paradiso est un œuvre de Sven Van Calster, empreinte de son style accessible bien connu. Il l’a composée dans l'hôtel éponyme pendant des vacances Alanya, en Turquie. Il s’est tout particulièrement attaché une distribution homogène de passages agréables dans tous les groupes d'orchestre et a assuré cette occasion les redoublements nécessaires afin qu'elle puisse ?tre jouée par la plupart des orchestres.

Frédéric Devreese est lun des compositeurs belges les plus renommés. Cest pourquoi Beriato Music a réalisé un coffret CD qui reprend ses principales uvres pour orchestre, adaptées par lui-m?me pour orchestre dharmonie. Initialement, la ballade est une forme fixe du lyrisme courtois de la fin du Moyen ge. Cette romance, signée Menno Bosgra, est une ballade, dédiée son épouse. Les courbes mélodiques sont fluides et éthérées. La trame est expressive et solennelle.  Romanza  est un poème d’amour en musique.

Cette nouvelle œuvre de Stef Minnebo permet votre orchestre de mettre en valeur ses qualités rythmiques. Tous les groupes sont sollicités, et cette composition convient parfaitement des orchestres jeunes et dynamiques.

Le thème initial entraînant et haut en couleur constitue un fil rouge tout au long de cette uvre. Il est suivi dune partie très rythmique, la mélodie emballante, et qui reste bien dans loreille. Vient ensuite une partie lente, presque méditative, avec un superbe solo de saxophone alto qui débouche sur un choral impressionnant. Vers la fin, les parties rapides sont répétées encore une fois, mais dans un arrangement

Edvard Grieg (1843-1907) est surtout connu pour son « Morgenstimmung » et ses concertos pour piano. Ce recueil "Lyriske stykker" op. 38 a initialement été écrit pour piano solo et comprend 5 actes courts dans des styles différents.

A loccasion de Steps, nous avons lhonneur de vous présenter Peter Miseur. Cette jolie oeuvre donne votre concert la dose de joie nécessaire pour le rendre inoubliable. Gr ce lorchestration transparente, Steps est réalisable par chaque orchestre.

To(o) Funk(y) est une mélodie d’ouverture courte mais vigoureuse, orchestrée par Juri Briat. Cette composition se compose d’un cocktail explosif de funk, swing et modern beat, enfin, l’ouverture idéale de votre concert.

Suite for symphonic wind band is a rich orchestral piece that taxes the musicians to the utmost. The first part starts with a lyric melody in the French horn section, to be taken over by the full orchestra, ending in a kind of "anarchistic entrada". Comme le titre laisse supposer, Dôky Doov est une oeuvre légère, largement garnie de mélodies aisées.Lorchestration riche prévoit que le matériel thématique se présente presque dans chaque groupe dinstruments.Votre snack musical de votre concert.
Dans cette oeuvre légère, le rôle principal est interprété par une bouilloire et vous pouvez, l’aide d’une lueur de fantaisie, offrir votre public un vrai spectacle!

Bagatelle veut dire «b?tise» ou «petite affaire». Cette composition est très légère écouter, nonobstant les changements de mesure continus.Le thème est d’abord proposé dans sa forme originale. Suivent après quelques variations qui mènent un canon simple. Cette charmante petite musique devrait se trouver sur chaque programme de concert.

Opening music est l’une des premières oeuvres pour orchestre de cuivres de Ben Haemhouts, initialement écrite la demande de la Fanfare St. Pieters Kapelle de Belgique. La lente et mystérieuse introduction présente le thème dominant composé des notes Fa, Do, Si bémol, Fa, une combinaison que l’on retrouve tout au long de l’oeuvre. Le titre de cette puissante marche est tiré d’une fonction du célèbre programme de notation musicale FINALE. Cette fonction, la „MASS MOVER”, permet de déplacer et de copier de grands morceaux de musique. Cette œuvre pleine de fraîcheur convient entre autres comme ouver-ture de concert, ou comme élément fixe au cœur d’un programme équilibré.

Andrew Lloyd Webber est de tous les temps le compositeur de comédies musicales jouissant de la plus grande renommée et du plus grand succès. Des uvres telles que Cats et Phantom of the Opera ont été jouées sur toutes les scènes du monde et les spectateurs se sont comptés par millions. Erik Mast a redécouvert ce petit bijou peu connu mais néanmoins de toute beauté, qui a dailleurs été récemment enregistré par Sarah

« Quest » veut dire « exploration » ou « recherche ». Cette oeuvre en quatre parties est une provocation pour chaque orchestre de fanfare ou d’harmonie. Tous les groupes d’instruments ont leur part dans cette musique qui ressemble la musique d’ un film.

Alors que les Mérovingiens la baptisèrent « Belisia », elle devint plus tard Bilzen.  The Beauty of Belisia  est une commande de la ville de Bilzen (Belgique), la ville natale de Bert Appermont. Deux thèmes jalonnent l’œuvre : le premier,mélancolique, rappelle le préjudice subi par la ville lors des nombreux épisodes de destructions . le second, plus héro que, illustre la force intérieure et le courage des habitants

Le compositeur norvégien Morten J. Wallin a dédié "New Horizons" ses trois enfants de 23, 20 et 8 ans. Chacun d’entre eux vit dans un univers qui lui est propre et se trouve un stade différent de la vie, il fréquente sa propre école, a ses propres amis et hobbys. Ils ont également leurs r?ves d’avenir, pour une vie qui offre toujours de nouvelles perspectives et ... un nouvel horizon.

description: Avec Charanga, Boudewijn Cox nous montre une autre facette de sa personnalité. Aventurez-vous dans les plus hautes sphères de la tessiture de la trompette ! Ce petit bijou pour trompette et orchestre est un intéressant mélange du répertoire solo pour trompette.

The Age of Aquarius is a sparkling composition that expresses the diverse aspects of a new astrological era in the sign of aquarius in 4 contrasting parts. As it refers to some classics in wind music, this composition is a true challenge for musician and listener.

Cette fantastique ouverture du compositeur belge Jef Maes a été le travail de fin d’études de Georges Moreau au cours de Jan Van der Roost. Les passages virtuoses y voisinent avec les lignes mélodiques richement instrumentées et créent une sonorité hautement symphonique. Une oeuvre d’ouverture de grand style pour votre concert, qui convient aussi parfaitement pour vous démarquer lors d’un concours.

Le passage au nouveau millénaire avait généré une certaine inquiétude, de la curiosité et même un certain optimisme. Le rythme  (tempo di bolero ), l’éclat des thèmes et les tournures harmoniques tumultueuses traduisent la fébrilité de l’attente, l’espoir d’un inconnu prometteur et la nécessité d’un dialogue entre les peuples pour un monde de paix. Une nouvelle génération est en marche.

Cette oeuvre comprend différentes parties courtes qui, comme le titre laisse supposer, garnissent d’une manière frivole, le m?me thème. Cette composition s’adresse surtout aux sections basses et a également une fonction didactique. Aussi très adapté pour des orchestres de jeunesses.
Cette marche classique est réalisable par chaque orchestre. Indispensable votre programme de concert traditionnel.

Edvard Grieg (1843-1907) est surtout connu pour sa suite Peer Gynt. Toutefois, cette Marche Funèbre est vraisemblablement une de ses compositions qui est le plus remarquable, originalement produit pour un orchestre d’harmonie.Erik Mast a opéré les ajustements nécessaires pour rendre cette musique réalisable pour l’occupation d’aujourd’hui.Un chef d’oeuvre que vous n’avez pas encore découvert !

Une petite composition légère et agréable du Belge Frank van Baelen, un talent issu du cours de Jan Van Der Roost. Avec ce petit morceau, le compositeur fait la preuve de son caractère universel: il compose d'une part des morceaux difficiles pour des concours, et d'autre part de petits morceaux légers et faciles.

Comme d’habitude, mieux connu comme My Way, est devenu un des plus grands succès du monde gr ce l’interprétation de Frank Sinatra. Juri Briat s’est déj fait remarquer avec l’arrangement de The Rose. Cette fois-ci, il a nouveau réussi mettre son cachet sur cette ballade originale française en lui donnant une interprétation brillante.

Aperitivo Energico est une oeuvre d’ouverture pleine de vitalité, dans laquelle des thèmes enjoués se succèdent aisément. La garantie pour un bon début de votre concert. L’intégralité a été instrumentée de sorte que cette composition est réalisable pour presque chaque orchestre. C’est le mérite de Philip Gorts, que nous vous présentons pour la première fois.

Adagio est une oeuvre assez courte mais intense pour un orchestre et cor. L’accompagnement simple permet que cette composition de Boudewijn Cox soit réalisable pour quasiment chaque orchestre. Ce petit bijou a été composé pour le fameux corniste belge Ivo Hadermann.

Gigantesques tours carrées étages, les ziggourats mésopotamiennes ont toujours fasciné les hommes. L’une des plus célèbres est celle de l’ancienne Babylone, ville que le roi Nemrod appelait Babel. La Tour de Babel devait être la porte du ciel, mais elle devint le symbole de l’orgueil et de la confusion des langues. Elle s’y dévoue avec une ambition implacable, mais l’affection oculaire grave qui la touche rend la situation de plus en plus difficile. Le compositeur russe Dmitri Schostakovitsch (1906 - 1975) écrivit, en plus de 15 symphonies, également de la musique de ballet et quelques opéras. L’opéra le plus connu de ce compositeur qui fut réprimé par le régime communiste est « Lady Macbeth of the Mtsensk District », dont Steven Verhaert a fait une sélection. Cet arrangement exceptionnel est un défi pour tout orchestre de haut niveau.
titre: Suite (From Lady MacBeth Of The Mtsensk District)

Ceci nous mène une impressionnante apothéose, suivie d’une chute similaire l’ascension. Cette marche de concert innovante est idéale pour les jeunes ensembles dynamiques et offre la possibilité d’imprégner au son une culture musicale.

Le thème d’ouverture est réexposé avec brio dans les mesures finales. Correspondant idéalement aux orchestres dynamiques,  A Taste for Music  est également devenu le slogan des éditions Beriato

Une mélodie généreuse et solennelle répartie entre différents groupes fait suite une fanfare majestueuse. Après un trio rafraîchissant, l’œuvre s’achève sur une fin triomphante.

Katinka est un nom typiquement russe relativement courant. Cette oeuvre simple est basée sur un thème slave qui traduit une certaine tristesse et une certaine mélancolie. Laissez-vous emporter par cette mélodie mélancolique qui monte jusqu un climax pour disparaître nouveau en silence dans les plaines de Sibérie.

Recalls signifie tout simplement « souvenirs ». Cette célèbre marche rythmée agrémentera tout concert. Compte tenu du franc succès qu’elle remporta par del les frontières allemandes, son titre original « Unter dem Doppeladler » a été traduit. La marche s’est m?me hissée au rang de nombre de marches de Sousa. Ce classique convient tout ensemble et est conseiller aux amateurs de marches classiques traditionnelles.

Ce numéro léger plongera coup s r votre public dans l’ambiance méridionale. Ne manquez pas ce numéro la fois simple et entraînant, surtout si votre ensemble compte un trompettiste mexicain. La section médiane contient un passage (facultatif) où quelques « Gringo´s » se parlent en espagnol (textes disponibles). Plongez-vous au coeur du Mexique et agrémentez votre concert d’une pincée de bossa nova !

En 1962, ce titre s’est classé pendant plusieurs semaines dans les hit-parades internationaux. Ce grand classique défie véritablement le temps et connaît aujourd’hui encore un franc succès. Un arrangement simple signé Sven Van Calster, accompagné d’une instrumentation transparente, en font un morceau la portée de tout ensemble.
titre: Those Were The Days My Friend

description: ‘Join the club’ est une composition facile et agréable dans le style swing du belge Stef Minnebo. Cette oeuvre est réalisable par chaque orchestre, gr ce l’instrumentation simple et l’orchestration large.
Ce tube de l’été a occupé la première place des hit-parades internationaux pendant plusieurs semaines. Donnez votre public l’occasion de se déhancher une fois encore sur cette « Ketchup Song » !
Room for Two  est une pièce facile et pleine de légèreté. Elle s'adresse tout particulièrement aux Orchestres Juniors ou aux formations instrumentation variable.

Song for Nico laisse supposer que cette oeuvre a été écrite pour quelqu’un de très spécial... Cette petite perle, romantique souhait, est un moment de calme qui a sa place dans tout programme de concert. Elle contient de jolies mélodies dans tous les groupes d’instruments, toujours accompagnées de signaux d’entrée pour les éventuels orchestres incomplets.

Il est de tradition de toujours intégrer une véritable marche classique dans un concert. Les traditions sont faites pour ?tre respectées. C’est également le cas chez nos voisins allemands. Reiner Lüghausen a puisé son inspiration dans les marches allemandes.

En termes de style,  Aldacum  se rapproche des musiques de film de John Williams et ne manquera pas de captiver un large public.

Le traitement richement thématique, l'orchestration colorée et les hardis changements de mesures donnent cette oeuvre un caractère original et emballant. Extr?mement approprié pour un concours ou un concert.
Wondering Music se compose d’un choix varié des classiques de Walt Disney et des chants de Noël. Réalisable par chaque orchestre et en particulier par des orchestres de jeunesses.

Pour son oeuvre  The New King’s Dances  (Les danses du nouveau Roi), le compositeur s’est inspiré des thèmes de cinq danses et chants originaux, traditionnellement entendus lors du Fischertag :  Tanz der Schneider  (La danse des tailleurs),  Schmotz, Schmotz  (Baisers, baisers),  Fischerländler  (La tyrolienne des pêcheurs),  Fischerpolka  (La polka des pêcheurs) et la  Marche de Laridah  (du compositeur Max Hempel).

Originaire du Massachusetts, États-Unis, le ´J. Geils Band´ privilégiait le blues-rock dans les années 1970, mais adopta un style plus commercial dès le début des années 1980. Ce changement de direction lui fut profitable : l’album  Freeze Frame  se vendit par millions ! Le morceau éponyme, deuxième titre tiré de l’album, a toujours eu beaucoup de succès auprès d’un public international.

description: Composée par Stef Minnebo, Concert Pitch est une spectaculaire pièce d’ouverture de concert qu’il conviendrait d’ajouter votre répertoire. Elle débute par un motif musical qui pourra servir de musique de fond lorsque le présentateur entamera son discours de bienvenue, puis sur un geste du chef,l’orchestre amorcera le deuxième thème, brillant et pétillant pour une ouverture de concert des plus festives.

Cette splendide oeuvre méditative du compositeur espagnol Teo Aparicio Barberán est un élément unique du répertoire pour cornet ou bugle, sans doute linstrument solo le plus intéressant dans un orchestre. Placez votre soliste sous les feux de la rampe avec cette oeuvre émouvante et pleine délégance.

Armonia Serrano a une connaissance étendue de la musique traditionnelle juive. Son arrangement pétillant de la  Danse des Chassidim Chabad  est fidèle la version originale. Un grand moment de joie et de gaîté dans la pure tradition yiddish.

Ceremonial Hymn, du compositeur hollandais Menno Bosgra, est une oeuvre de caractère solennel et méditatif. Les belles mélodies qui ornent cet hymne, soutenues par des motifs rythmiques réguliers, offriront votre auditoire un agréable moment de réflexion et de détente. Ceremonial Hymn est également une excellente oeuvre de concours.

Three Evocations  s’adresse la fois aux formations complètes et/ou incomplètes (voix dédoublées).
