description: Friends of Freedom , du jeune compositeur belge, Karel Deseure, s’ouvre avec une courte fanfare suivie d’un  Allegro , léger et pétillant, dans lequel apparaissent des mélodies virtuoses et plusieurs changements rythmiques bien ciselés. Une reprise du thème d’ouverture - dans une orchestration élargie - vient conclure le développement.

The Lost Chord  est un célèbre cantique anglais, composé par Sir Arthur Sullivan, au chevet de son frère malade. Le climat d’ouverture est mélancolique et intimiste. La mélodie gagne graduellement en intensité pour culminer sur l’entrée de l’orgue ( ad lib. ). Cet arrangement, d’Erik Mast, porte un nouveau regard sur l’œuvre de Sullivan. Le style et les détails sont soignés, les voix suffisamment dédoublées.

Albert Miles a réalisé un arrangement facile jouer sur la base dune sélection des plus grands hits des années 60: "The Good Old Days of Rock & Roll !!". En entendant ce medley qui comporte des fragments de "Rock Around The Clock", "Shake, Rattle&Roll", "Mona Lisa", "Are you Lonesome Tonight", "Jailhouse Rock", ... vos auditeurs auront grand peine rester assis !
sous_titre: Rock Around The Clock - Shake, Rattle & Roll - Mona Lisa - Are you Lonesome Tonight - Jailhouse Rock

description: Reiner Lüghausen a arrangé quelques-uns des hits planétaires du musicien de jazz, chanteur, pianiste et acteur Nat King Cole. Des morceaux inoubliables. Qui, en effet, ne connaît pas  Unforgettable  ,  Fly me to the Moon  ,  Mona Lisa  , et  Lazy, Dazy, Crazy ? Cet arrangement rappelle la période où ces morceaux ont été instrumentés, avec notamment la section compacte des instruments vent qui marque cette époque.
titre: A Portrait Of Nat King Cole

description: Cette superbe ballade est entrée dans les annales de la musique pop gr ce l'interprétation magistrale qu'en a faite Julie Gold. Un arrangement réussi de ce thème est celui d'un autre arrangeur maison, Georges Moreau. Il est jouable par tout orchestre.

‘Late Night Music’ nous invite nous replonger dans la mouvance des années septante, avec des superhits : ‘In the Stone’, ‘Can you feel it’, ‘Relight my Fire’ et ‘I’m so excited.Cet arrangement de Juri Briat alterne les morceaux de rock, le son swinguant des bigbands et une ambiance « blue light » empreinte de romance.

Olhos Verdes  signifie tout simplement "yeux verts". Un petit intermède plaisant et léger pour tous les concerts. Son rythme entraînant et sa mélodie excitante sont garantes de la bonne humeur de chacun.
Kiki Dee a fait de ce morceau - toujours en vogue aujourd’hui - une chanson inoubliable. Il est surtout connu chez nous comme morceau final du programme "De Notenclub".
titre: I've Got The Music In Me

description: Ce magnifique solo, l’aria "O, Mio Babbino Caro" tiré de l'opéra de Puccini "Gianni Schicchi", a été arrangé par Georges Moreau pour Ben Haemhouts, qui a été longtemps responsable de l'euphonie du groupe belge "Brassband Midden Brabant". Ce solo est assez facile et représente un véritable enrichissement de l'euphonie de votre répertoire. Pour saxophone ou cor solo.

Le slow par excellence des ann es 80, chant par Roberta Flack. Peut- tre cette chanteuse n’est-elle plus tr s connue du jeune public, mais elle tient sa place dans l’histoire comme une des divas qui ont ensorcel le monde. Back into time, un moment de tendresse dans vos concerts.

Rhapsodia  est une composition contrastante qui transporte l’auditeur dans une aventure musicale riche en émotions. Robert Finn illustre toute une palette de sentiments humains travers une texture proche de la musique de film. vous de relever le défi !

La Terre, le Feu, l’Eau et l’Air sont les quatre éléments indispensables toute forme de vie. Ils imprègnent notre conception du monde, notre pensée et nos émotions. De tous les grands principes, la division de l’univers en quatre éléments fondamentaux est certainement un des plus anciens. Exuberante!  est l’une des deux oeuvres commandées par le Collège Xinmin de Singapour qui a célébré en 2010 son 65e anniversaire et fut créée lors du concert de gala honorant ce jubilé. L’ensemble du panel instrumental est représenté dans cette composition et les lignes mélodiques sont doublées par différents pupitres, faisant de cette exubérante marche une oeuvre facilement jouable par tous les orchestres.

Along The River  est une oeuvre de commande pour l’Orchestre Vent de Kundl (Autriche) en hommage au 225e anniversaire de sa création. Hermann Pallhuber, ayant vécu proximité des gorges Kundler Klamm, s’est inspiré des impressions ressenties au bord du précipice. Le bruit de l’eau frémissante, le lever du soleil derrière les sommets embrumés qui se dressent devant vos yeux ainsi que les vues panoramiques

Happy Days (Les jours heureux), chronique savoureuse de l’Amérique des années 50, est une série télévisée culte qui déchaîna une vague d’enthousiasme dans les années 70-80. Le générique respire l’insouciance, la spontanéité et la fraîcheur de la jeunesse. Que du bonheur !

Dans cette divertissante Suite de Noël, Filip Ceunen nous propose un arrangement facile pour orchestre d’harmonie, de trois chants anciens qui embellissent, de nos jours encore, la magie de la Nativité.  Mon beau sapin, C’est Noël joie sur la Terre  et  Noël Noël  composent cette pièce dont les lignes mélodiques ont été réparties sur plusieurs sections afin que tout orchestre puisse interpréter  A Christmas Suite

Dans cette oeuvre, Bart Picqueur illustre les quatre principaux ingrédients d’une coupe la fraise dans quatre esquisses musicales. sous_titre: a sweet suite to fresh up a hot Italian summer

Il ne s'agit pas vraiment d'une oeuvre programme - le compositeursouhaitait mettre pleinement en avant les capacités du cor en tant que voix solo et enrichir le répertoire pour ce superbe instrument. Vous obtiendrez une délicieuse boisson, la tequila frappée.Prenez une trompette solo, combinez votre soliste l’orchestre et parsemez d’éclats de batterie. Vous obtiendrez une splendide pièce pour trompette solo et orchestre vent intitulée  Tequini .

The Ultimate “Europe” Collection  est un medley explosif de musique rock des années 1980. Le groupe Europe, l’origine nommé Force, a vu le jour en 1979 dans la ville de Uppland Väsby, en Suède. Au début, il écrivait du rock progressif mais il changea bientôt d’orientation pour adopter un son plus accessible, dominé par les claviers. Le groupe devint mondialement célèbre en 1986 gr ce la chanson  The Final Countdown .

Outre 4 concertos pour piano, Sergei Rachmaninov (1873-1943) a également écrit quelques symphonies. Le solo de clarinette extrait de ladagio de sa deuxième symphonie opus 27 est sans doute lune des plus belles mélodies de cette période.

Fille du roi Prabu Munding Wangi, la cour entière et ses sujets l’adoraient, de même que son père le roi. Si on le souhaite, le public ou un choeur peuvent chanter en même temps, auquel cas le chef d'orchestre leurdonnera les indications appropriées. Créé en septembre 2010, ESSENTIA est un collectif de musiciens de la ville d’Essen, une commune néerlandophone située au nord de la Belgique. L’oeuvre  The Essence of Music  a été écrite afin de célébrer la fondation de ce jeune et dynamique orchestre vent. Résumant parfaitement cette initiative et ses réussites musicales, cette composition est une excellente pièce d’ouverture de concert.

Nikola Rimsky-Korsakov (1844-1908) composa son opéra  La Nuit de Noël  dans les années 1894-95. Cette oeuvre fut créée le 10 décembre 1895 Saint-Pétersbourg. Signé par Rimski-Korsakov lui-même, le livret s’inspire d’une histoire de Nikola Gogol qui, quelques années plus tôt, avait servi de matériel thématique un opéra de Piotr Ilitch Tcha kovski. description: Le grand succès ‘Love is all around’ de WetWetWet a été magistralement arrangé par George Moreau.

Barbara Streisand est actrice et chanteuse, mais elle est surtout connue pour ses somptueuses ballades. L’ « Evergreen » arrangé pour saxophone et orchestre est sans doute la plus célèbre chanson interprétée par la diva.

‘Play that funky Music’ est un éternel classique qui, depuis son premier succès dans les années septante, est encore souvent interprété et diffusé. Le groove grisant et entraînant garantit une ambiance torride. L’ambiance n’atteint réellement son paroxysme que quand l’orchestre maîtrise bien le groove. A la fin, tout le monde - lisez tout ceux qui ne jouent pas d’un instrument vent - peuvent accompagner en chantant.
Ce medley rassemble trois des plus grands succès de l'icône de la chanson française, Michel Sardou :  La bataille ,  Une fille aux yeux clairs  et  Les lacs du Connemara .

Le Sirtaki est une danse populaire traditionnelle grecque. Le Sirtaki de Teodorakis extrait du film « Zorba Le Grec » est, sans doute, le plus célèbre de tous les temps. Cette danse, lente et posée au début, saccélère pour finir en une étourdissante extase !

Une aria (un air) est une grande mélodie vocale, interprétée par un soliste, accompagnée par l’orchestre. Elle permet une pause lyrique au cœur du drame. L’ Aria  de Robert Finn est écrite pour un soliste instrumental. The Bermuda Mystery (Le mystère des Bermudes)  est une œuvre en deux tableaux de caractères opposés. Si le premier tableau est mystérieux, menaçant et tumultueux, le second est plus apaisé. La trame évolue calmement mais contient en filigrane des fragments sombres du premier tableau. Le mystère reste éternel…

Cette musique pleine de fantaisie semble tout droit sortie du grand écran, sauf quelle nest associée aucun film ! Lidole du pop néerlandais, Rob de Nijs, est depuis des années une valeur s?re de la pop aux Pays-Bas. Filip Sandras a réussi faire un intéressant medley de ses morceaux les plus fameux.

description: Cette suite est basée sur la comédie musicale  In the Shadow of Napoleon  qui connut un succès énorme lors de sa première Worms en Allemagne le 21 juillet 2014. Qui ne saurait ressentir l’immense pouvoir que recèlent la tranquillité et la beauté des montagnes ? Vastes prairies, crêtes en dents de scie, gorges romantiques, cascades bruyantes, lacs idylliques...  Mountain Lake  dépeint les aspects bienparticuliers d’un tel paysage : le calme, la majesté et la profondeur de l’eau, et tous les secrets féeriques que cache un lac de montagne.
sous_titre: Fantasy on a wild and romantic alpine landscape

Cet air entraînant de Tina, la diva du pop, est un morceau plein d’énergie. Trois grands noms de l’histoire du pop ont composé ce morceau: le producteur Phil Spector et le couple de compositeurs Jeff Barrie et Ellie Greenwich, spécialement pour Tina Turner. En 1959, le chanteur belge d’origine italienne, Rocco Granata (1938), décide de produire lui-même son premier 45 tours. Le seul nom d’Astor Piazzolla (1921-1992), le plus grand interprète du  tango nuevo , incarne la magie de cette danse mystérieuse, séductrice et sensuelle. L’immortel  Libertango , une des plus célèbres pièces de Piazzolla, souligne toute l’attention que le compositeur a accordé cette forme musicale dans laquelle le rythme et les couleurs sont essentiels.

La Méduse est le nom de la déesse serpent nord-africaine qui, vers 1400 avant JC, fut le symbole de la sagesse féminine et du mystère féminin. Daprès la légende, personne ne pouvait soulever son voile car quand on voyait ses yeux, on entrevoyait sa propre mort...Le mystère et la fatalité sont musicalement décrits dans cette composition, qui assimile des éléments de musique de film et de musique légère.

Tant les paroles sujettes controverse que le rythme groove irrésistible font de ce morceau un moment fort de votre concert ne rater sous aucun prétexte. Il vous permet en outre de tourner les projecteurs sur votre groupe de percussion.

Robert Finn est, comme bon nombre dentre nous, un grand amateur de cuisine et de vin dItalie. Quand on se sent super bien, on peut s'attaquer tout ! C'est le sentiment qu'exprime l'énergique piéce  Cloud9 !  L'expression -to be on cloud 9- signifie -être aux anges-, alorspréparez-vous voyager sur un nuage de bonheur ! Homeward Voyage  (De retour la maison) est une oeuvre de commande écrite l’automne 2012, la demande de l’orchestre d’harmonie du Collège de Shimofukuda (Japon). Written in an invigorating 6/8 style, Henry Mancini's famous movie march will add a spark of life to any concert. Every section of the band gets a chance to shine in this toe-tapper that's sure to become an audience favorite.

Certainly the songs by Randy Newman and score by ElmerBernstein contribute greatly to its humor and charm. This broad and sweeping theme is heard throughout the film Gettysburg, which received critical acclaim for its portrayal of one of the most important events in American history. John Moss has done a remarkable job arranging Randy Edelman's memorable theme for band.

Featured most recently on the hit TV series Glee, here is a dynamic arrangement of the stunning production number from the Broadway musical Wicked. Sure to be a crowd favorite!

Including the popular swing hits Flip, Flop and Fly: Rock This Town and Jump, Jive and Wail, here is an entertaining medley for band that will have everyone dancing in the aisles. Paul Murtha has skillfully adapted this fun, jazzystyle for the concert stage.

This inspirational song performed by Andrea Bocelli over the end credits for Disney's A Christmas Carol is an ideal concert finale for your entire music program. In addition, it can be performed with or without chorus.

From the groundbreaking movie blockbuster Avatar, here is the main theme used in the end credits. Johnnie Vinson's sensitive arrangement features light woodwind scoring in the beginning, then builds into a powerful setting for theentire ensemble.

Recorded by renowned vocal group Celtic Woman on the CD  A New Journey , this beautiful ballad features a haunting melody and rich harmonies. Sean O'Loughlin brings us a moving adaptation for band with a nice variety in scoring and emotional pacing.

Elliot's works at the grade two level have become important editions in the young band literature.  English Folk Suite is an outstanding medley of British folk songs and serves as the ideal teaching piece.

It's just what you need for your holiday concert. Includes: I'll Be Home For Christmas, The Christmas Song, Frosty The Snowman and Rudolph, The Red-Nosed Reindeer.

The third movement,  A Brass Thing , features an eclectic blend of styles and striking sonorities and is skillfully adapted for wind band by Richard Saucedo. Duration 5:30. (Grade 4)

Here is a bold and adventurous overture that works great as a concert opener. Reminiscent of an epic film score, this original composition features dynamic brass fanfares, sweeping woodwind lines and a wealth of stylistic andemotional variety. Impressive writing for mature groups. (Grade 4) (4:25)

This impressive and historically significant work is found on state lists all across the country and is highly respected as an important contribution to the contemporary literature for concert band. Composed in 1968 and memorializing the 1968 Soviet bloc invasion of Czechoslovakia, Husa arranged this for orchestra soon after. One year later Husa was awarded the Pulitzer Prize for his String Quartet No. 3.
Arranged for Concert Band by W. Herbert.

You can't lose when you get your administrators or other staff members involved in your performance. Teachers from Outer Space is a hilarious comedy skit for band that lets three or more of your staff members temporarily become outer space aliens and use every corny outer space joke in the book! If you are looking for a funny contrast highlight - greetings Earthling, you've found it!

This nice processional style piece will work in the concert and contest venue as well as at the graduation or awards ceremony. The stately tempo and rich scoring help your young musicians to sound their best. Carefully controlledranges and rhythms mean the piece can be prepared with limited rehearsal time.

This nice easy overture-style festival or concert piece will show off your band at its best. The exciting primary theme is contrasted with an engaging slow section and there are plenty of musical concepts to teach which are righton target for musicians at this level. Consider opening your next concert with Challenger Point. Dur: 3:05

James Curnow skillfully brings one of Tchaikovsky's most memorable symphonic themes to the concert band stage with this new arrangement. It's always a good idea to let your band members become familiar with great orchestrathemes. Whether used as a concert centerpiece or an exciting finale you'll want to have this mainstay of Romantic era music in your library. Dur: 4:45

Your young players will enjoy the mystery and grandeur of this descriptive piece about the isolated 12th-century Norman keep. Once a strong fortress, it is now little more than some stone walls and bits of rooms. What history has been made here? The colorful percussion and rich harmonies are expressive and intriguing. There's something for everyone in this stately original. Majestic!

James Curnow's clever arrangement of Jingle Bells masterfully keeps the range and rhythm demands at a pre-grade 1 level while assuring that all the players have fun in the preparation and performance. Every section is fullyinvolved, and the low woodwinds and brass get a little special time all their own. Great step dynamics are the perfect opportunity to make sure your players show a significant difference at each

This joyous arrangement is a great opener for your winter concert. Three well-known bell carols unite to make a sparkling and memorable treat - and what a great teaching tool for the concept of bell-tones that appear in numerousplaces. Brisk and engaging with lots of built-in contrasts, it's a sure winner.

What a great energetic way to open your Christmas concert and bring focus to the joyful sounds of the season! Themes from Spain, Czechoslovakia, Poland, England and France lead us on a delightful Christmas tour, and James Curnow'soutstanding orchestration technique ensures that all the musicians have rewarding parts to play. You'll enjoy the melodic twists and turns as the consistent unifying tempo charges implacably

This little gem will win over your audience from the very start. What a clever and well-crafted way to open your next winter concert! Sounding more advanced than it plays, this very accessible arrangement is a great choice for thewinter concert. Sparkling colors and creative melodic excursions make rehearsals as much fun as the performance. (Grade 1-1/2)

A refreshing and energetic treatment of one of the all-time best loved carols, Angels We Have Heard on High. Young musicians will love rehearsing and performing this stylistically creative little gem. The captivating developmentof the middle section of the piece and lots of contrasting instrumentation throughout makes this arrangement a wonderful experience for all. (Grade 1)

You've heard of the legendary Tyrannosaurus Rex. Well, this Tyrannosaurus ROCKS! Another fun one for Beginning Band by Mike Hannickel, it's as easy as can be but the kids will love it. If you have an old sousaphone and a baritonesax mouthpiece you can make a mighty Tyrann-o-Phone for the optional solo at the end of the piece. (Grade 1/2)

Mariah Carey made a huge addition to our holiday listening experience with her Merry Christmas album. This arrangement includes three of those tunes woven into a medley by Joe Murphy: All I Want for Christmas Is You · Miss You Most (At Christmas Time) · Christmas (Baby Please Come Home).

titre: Go Tell it on the Mountain

description: This lush and richly scored arrangement by Larry Kerchner will be especially rewarding for younger bands. The melody of It Came Upon a Midnight Clear is beautifully intermingled with Dona Nobis Pacem in this lovely setting.
titre: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear

description: The two melodies we know as Away in a Manger are lovingly intertwined - yet another Tom Wallace masterpiece.
This ingenious and appealing arrangement by Jeff Simmons merges The First Noel and Pachelbel's Canon in D.

Composed in the style of a military quickstep, Pas Redoublé is a concert march reminiscent of the gallops by Offenbach and other 19 century composers. Transcribed for band by Arthur Frackenpohl in 1972, this work has retained a prominent position in the wind band literature. Dur: 3:20 (Grade 4)

This gem from 1985 has steadily become one of the classic repertoire pieces for young bands. Even though it is heavily cross-cued making it suitable for smaller bands, this beautiful work is rich in melodic content, variedscoring, and marvelous counterlines and harmonies. An effective performance vehicle that also teaches legato style and musical sensitivity. Dur: 4:00 (Grade 3)

The Dylan Thomas poem Do Not Go Gentle into That Good Night was the motivation for this musical composition. While not a programmatic depiction of the poem, the work attempts to recreate the essence of the poem in sound. Theopening motive, representative of the life force, permeates much of the work. The use of sound layers - in the form of polytonal hymns - calls to mind the struggles and persistence of the human
titre: Do Not Go Gentle Into That Good Night

description: For that first holiday concert, here is a wonderful and very easy setting of O Come Emmanuel in an expressive style.
A Puerto Rican folk carol is the basis for this clever holiday feature that has plenty of Latin percussion and performance options.

Paul Jennings as created an outstanding setting for this familiar canon for beginning groups. Starting softly with the woodwinds, the piece builds gradually throughout giving every section a chance to play this marvelous melody.
Tchaikovsky's most frequently performed work is now available in a highly simplified version for young players. An impressive concert finale!
This Spanish-style concert march is carefully designed for beginning players. Strong melodies and careful part writing make this a winner for your first and second year players.

A ghoulish and sinister concoction that will delight any audience, particularly on a dark, dreary Friday night concert.  Jay's medley includes several musical nightmares that your players will love to play: Tales From The Crypt, Psycho, Jaws, and several other unnerving moments.
titre: Things That Go Bump In The Night

description: By interweaving fragments of several holiday favorites into a brilliant fanfare, James Curnow has crafted this spirited, festive work. A perfect opener for your next Christmas program.
The majesty and drama of this classic band piece has been carefully scored so that all parts are accessible to younger players.

From James Curnow's acclaimed series of orchestral masterwork editions for young band.  Includes four of the best known movements: The Sea and Sinbad's Ships, The Story Of The Kalendar Prince, The Young Prince And The Young Princess, and The Festival At Bagdad.
Curnow - Grade 3

This is the authentic version recorded by Whitney Houston and first performed at Super Bowl XXV during the Gulf War. Gifted arranger John Clayton has adapted the orchestral version he did for Whitney into this exhilarating arrangement for concert band. (Also available are compatible SATB, SAB and 2-Part choral voicings.)

This may well be one of the finest transcriptions ever done for developing bands.  Jim Curnow's carefully crafted arrangement features the six most loved movements of Moussorgsky's best-known work in settings that capture all the life and color of the original orchestral versions.  It includes: Promenade, The Old Castle, The Ox Cart, Ballet Of The Unhatched Chicks, Hut Of Baba Yaga, The Great Gate Of Kiev.
A jubilant way to open any holiday concert.
titre: Fanfare on Joy to the World

description: Already a classic of the Broadway/London stage, this Andrew Lloyd Webber theme is rich with dramatic appeal.  Easy and solidly scored by Jay Bocook.
titre: The Phantom of the Opera (Main Theme)

description: Here is a superb symphonic treatment of the best-known movements from Tchaikovsky's ballet. Not only does Jim Curnow capture the spirit of the orchestral version, but he has transformed the work into a setting that lets the modernconcert band sound its best.

This perennial favorite is a great way to feature one or more of your mallet percussionists.  The wind parts are extremely playable, and you will find that this piece works well at a variety of tempos.
Claude Smith has fashioned a brilliant, rhapsodic setting of this stirring carol. Christmas programming at its finest!

The popular Christmas classic  White Christmas  has been beautifully arranged for concert (wind) band by John Edmondson. This is easy enough to be played by High School bands, and yet full-sounding enough for more advanced bands.

Three of the Beatles' favourite hits are combined in this easy-to-play medley for developing groups. Eric Osterling's approach to young band writing ensures success for young players. Includes: Eleanor Rigby, Yesterday, and A Hard Day's Night.
sous_titre: Eleanor Rigby - Yesterday - A Hard Day's Night

description: 'Life Goes On'...the appropriate theme from an important TV drama, in an easy-play version.  A Beatles classic with a memorable hook and a great message.

We're pleased to release this vigorous and venturesome new piece from our foremost composer of mature wind band literature.  After a brilliant fanfare opening, the main theme is woven through variations in three large contrasting sections, with the fanfare returning to culminate this impressive and substantial work.  A superb new publication for serious bands.

We are proud to publish Alfred Reed's Third Symphony.  From the intensity of the opening meovement to the exquisite counterpoint of the finale, Dr. Reed draws the most from the resources of the contemporary concert band.  Written for the U.S. Air Force Band, this powerful three-movement work is certain to be a lasting contribution to the world of band literature.

Here's one of the most spectacular program number ever written!  Only the talents of Warren Barker could produce this rhapsodic medley of Sousa's favorite marches, ending with a version of The Stars And Stripes Forever that's sure to bring down the house.

Commissioned by the National Honorary Band Fraternity and Sorority of Kappa Kappa Psi, this brilliant work is exemplary of Claude T. Smith's consummate mastery of the concert band medium.  The four definitive movements reflect his rhythmic inventiveness, melodic exuberance and disinctive harmonic sense.

Here's a brilliant concert work from the master of the contemporary British band style.  Brassy and full of contrast, it maintains a forceful rhythmic vitality throughout.  A sensational addition to the repertoire.
Considered to be Van Morrison's signature hit, this was first recorded in the '60s but remains popular today. The rhythmic and upbeat feel of this solid arrangement will liven up any concert.

From the group Train, this popular hit has stayed on the charts for more than a year and is on track to becoming a pop classic. This great-sounding arrangement includes plenty of variety in scoring and textures while being easy tolearn and fun to perform.

Recorded by Coldplay, this enduring hit from 2003 represents some of the best elements of contemporary pop music - a catchy melody, well-constructed counterlines and harmonies, and an infectious groove. This arrangement by James Kazik effectively captures these elements from the original.

From the dramatic finale to the third film in the popular Twilight Saga movie series, here is Howard Shore's distinctive and memorable main theme. Robert Longfield's arrangement is carefully scored so that all sections (even lowbrass) get a chance to play the haunting theme.

Taking a similar approach to his popular Celtic Air and Dance, Michael Sweeney creatively combines two 17th-century carols (Bring a Torch, Jeanette, Isabella and Fum, Fum, Fum) into this attractive and distinctive setting for theholidays.

This famous duet from the 1940s has been recorded by countless artists over the years, and was featured in the hit movie Elf starring Will Ferrell. Here is a terrific-sounding arrangement for young players.

Cette ballade d’une beauté envo tante fut enregistrée pour la première fois par Cyndi Lauper en 1986. Elle reste toujours populaire et peut être retrouvée dans le nouveau film animé succès  Les Trolls . Un changement de tempo magnifique, parfait pour des bands.

Here is the perfect choice for an entertaining and unique holiday selection. Johnnie Vinson combines a light swing treatment of Jingle-Bell Rock, a lush version of Frosty the Snow Man, and a jazzy Here Comes Santa Claus into a terrific medley for young bands. Sure to be an audience pleaser!

Revived for the earthquake relief efforts in Haiti, We Are the World is still a powerful and moving anthem of hope and unity. Here is an arrangement for young bands that will go together quickly and sound great.

The Fab Four exploded on the American music scene with a banner year of hits in 1964. This medley of Beatle favorites includes I Want to Hold Your Hand, And I Love Her and Twist and Shout. It was a good year!
sous_titre: I Want to Hold Your Hand - And I Love Her - Twist and Shout

description: Taking the musical phrase dashing through the snow and weaving it around original material, John Moss has created a wonderful work for band that captures the flavor and joy of the holiday season.

Booker T. & the MG's recorded this iconic instrumental hit in the early '60s, and it continues to be popular in film and TV decades later. Instantly recognizable, this is sure to be a hit with all audiences.

Picking up right where the popularity of the first High School Musical left off, the second movie offers more catchy tunes and energetic rhythms. Here is a solidly scored medley including What Time Is It, You Are the Music in Me,and All for One. Dur: 4:00

After 18 seasons of unparalleled success on television, Homer and all the gang have finally made it to the big screen! Here is a dynamite arrangement of one of the most unique and recognizable theme songs ever!

With select new themes from the blockbuster third Pirates movie along with a hint of the familiar earlier melodies, this very playable version for younger bands is sure to be a hit with audiences and students alike!

How many times have you wondered what to do with all those bell players? Here's a great solution in this clever holiday arrangement featuring 2-part mallet percussion (bells or vibes). Including “ Joy to the World ” and “ Angels We Have Heard on High ”, these players finally get the spotlight they deserve!
Christina Aguilera's big hit is rhythmic and dynamic. With hot ensemble riffs and dynamic percussion parts, this is certain to add some excitement to your next concert.

With the reality TV show You're the One That I Want leading up to the Broadway revival, the ever popular musical Grease is enjoying renewed interest. Here's one of the big hits from the show in an arrangement playable by beginninggroups.
Filled with rock energy and rhythmic drive, here is an easy arrangement of this hit song from Disney's High School Musical. Your percussion section will have fun with this one! Dur: 2:00

Using a beloved carol as a point of departure, John has crafted a marvelous piece for holiday concerts. Sensitive and lyrical in nature, it also features nice emotional pacing and superb scoring for young bands. Dur: 2:40
titre: A Shepherd's Carol (based on The First Noel)

description: John Moss has taken this familiar holiday melody and crafted an up-tempo and lively setting all in 4/4 (rather than 6/8). This unique version is sure to be a welcome addition to your band's holiday offerings. Carefully scored togive every section interesting parts. Dur: 2:15
Featuring the mega hits Thriller, Somewhere Out There, and Footloose, here is a hard-hitting medley for young players that is sure to be enjoyed by all. The '80s never sounded so good!

Combining the familiar Canon in D with a multitude of popular Christmas carols, this clever and unique arrangement for beginning bands will be the talk of the concert. See how many tunes you can identify. includes:  Canon In D; The First Noel; Go, Tell It On The Mountain; Good King Wenceslas; Hark! The Herald Angels Sing; Jingle Bells; Jolly Old St. Nicholas; Joy To The World; Up On The Housetop; We Wish You A Merry
From a hit in the '60s by Johnny Rivers to frequent use in contemporary movies, this is everyone's favorite spy theme in an easy version.

Ray Charles' genius is evident in the wide variety of songs he recorded and made his own. Johnnie's solidly scored medley for young players includes such Ray Charles classics as: Georgia on My Mind, What'd I Say and Hallelujah ILove Her So.

One of the all-time favorite production numbers for the Canadian Brass is this clever arrangement that combines The Hallelujah Chorus with When the Saints Go Marching In. Johnnie has created an easier version of this classicallowing it to be performed by younger groups. What a great idea! (Grade 21/2)

This magnificent march was actually composed by Eric Osterling in 1979. In this new edition, Eric has kept the chromatic flare and distinctive style but adapted it to the needs of younger players. Now even small and inexperienced bands can enjoy this march classic!

The 1960s were a golden time for rock and roll, and many of the hits came from across the ocean. Here is a fun collection of British imports including Downtown (Petula Clark), Ferry 'Cross the Mersey (Gerry & The Pacemakers) and IWant to Hold Your Hand (The Beatles).

Herb Alpert and the Tijuana Brass made this a huge hit in the 1960s, and now your trumpets can be the hit of the concert with this easy version. Bring the festive atmosphere of a bull fight to your next concert (without the bull).

Written in a two-beat style and in a minor key, this is a fun little ragtime number that will be a nice change of pace on any concert. The clarinets get some noodling time in their low register and there are some nice full ensemble passages as well.
From Kermit the Frog's lily pad to your concert stage, this easy setting of the Muppets' best-known ballad is sure to be a favorite with audiences and students alike. Nicely scored for young bands.
From the motion picture We Were Soldiers and featured during the Ronald Reagan memorial service in Washington, D.C., this beautiful hymn is presented in an easy and moving setting.
titre: The Mansions of the Lord (from We Were Soldiers)

description: Johnnie Vinson presents three holiday favorites all treated in an easy-flowing swing style in this very attractive medley for young players. Here's a great way to teach swing in a unique sounding arrangement for Christmas. Includes  Deck the Hall ,  Jingle Bells  and the Irving Berlin classic  White Christmas .

Introduce your young players to the music of Duke Ellington with this easy arrangement of one of the Duke's classics. Written in a medium slow swing style, this one will make your band sound great and is sure to be a hit with theparents.
The distinctive music of Charlie Brown and the Peanuts gang comes alive in this enjoyable arrangement by Paul Murtha. Fun for all audiences!

Opening with the slow style of a New Orleans funeral march (with an optional combo), the arrangement then shifts gears to an uptempo Dixieland celebration. Marvelous and effective writing for younger players.
titre: Just a Closer walk With Thee

description: Discovery Series - Grade 1.5 This unforgettable theme from the original Spider-Man television series was brought back for the recent blockbuster movie. With a catchy melody and a driving rock feel, this is a guaranteed favorite with students and audiences alike.

The distinctive harmonies and sounds of the Renaissance period are used in a wonderfully effective setting by Johnnie Vinson. Including Carol of the Birds, Veni Emmanuel and In Dulci Jubilo, this festive and unique arrangement also inlcudes optional recorder parts.

Some of the early classic TV cartoon shows generated the most memorable themes. Paul's fast paced and well-written arrangement includes I'm Popeye the Sailor Man, Casper the Friendly Ghost and The Mighty Mouse Theme (Here I Come to Save the Day). This is sure to be an audience favorite!

From the popular musical Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat here is an exciting yet easy version of the main song. The introduction starts quietly in 3/4 before launching into a driving rock style. This excellent arrangement features solid scoring that will sound great with beginning players.
sous_titre: From Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat

description: After years of writing clever and memorable tunes for the movies (Toy Story and A Bug's Life to name a few) Randy Newman finally won a much deserved Grammy for this song from the hit movie Monsters, Inc. Michael Brown has skillfully arranged it for young players in a medium 2-beat swing style.
titre: If I Didn't Have You (from Monsters, Inc.)

description: Here is the distinctive Duke Ellington classic in a very easy setting for band. By using a moderately fast tempo in 4/4 Michael was able to capture the feel of the original using nothing faster than a quarter note in the wind parts. The percussion are featured briefly and compliment the style of the arrangement very nicely.
This popular song from The Sound of Music can serve as a nice change of pace for a holiday concert or a program selection for any occasion. Well-scored with easy rhythms.
titre: My Favorite Things (from The Sound of Music)

Johnnie Vinsonskillfully combines bold statements and driving rhythmic figures, contrasted with beautiful yet simple melodies, in a work that provides both excitement and variety. Dur: 5:30
Pokémon est de retour! Voici un superbe arrangement du thème original avec un rythme de rock rapide et des mélodies accrocheuses. Facile apprendre, et amusant jouer !
Originally a hit for Louis Armstrong in 1967, this touching ballad continues to be popular today and is heard regularly in TV and film. Nicely arranged here for beginning players.

From the blockbuster film The Hunger Games, here is an effective setting of the main themes from the soundtrack carefully scored for young players. The power and emotion from the film really comes through in this easy arrangement.
Elton John and Tim Rice created memorable songs for Disney's The Lion King including this powerful ballad, arranged here for very young players.

This loving and dreamlike work captures the undulating rhythm of a mother rocking her child to sleep. The piece was inspired by classic Rudyard Kipling: “Oh! Hush thee, my baby, the night is behind us, And black are the waters that sparkled so green. The moon, o'er the combers, looks downward to find us, At rest in the hollows that rustle between.” Magical! (Grade 4)
Cette oeuvre, arrangée par Jan de Haan, se compose de deux parties admirablement entrelacées. L'introduction est suivie d'une version moderne du choral  Macht hoch die Tür .

Transcription for solo Alto Saxophone and Wind Band.   Written in 1970,  Robert Muczynski's  two-movement  Sonata for Alto Saxophone and Piano  has become a standard in the Saxophone repertoire.Anthony LaBounty has skilfully adapted this work for Wind Band accompaniment, carefully preserving the intent and style of the original with its unique blend of modern tonalities and syncopated rhythmic drive.

Argentine composer and bandoneon virtuoso Astor Piazzolla added new dimension to the traditional tango with his use of jazz elements, extended harmonies, and dissonance. His distinctive composition Street Tango is beautifully adapted here for band with its variety in textures, tempos, and almost improvisatory nature. A vibrant and appealing work for the concert stage! Dur: 4:30

In a famous moment from Manuel Penella's 1916 opera El Gato Montés (“The Wildcat”), a matador sings exuberantly to his beloved young gypsy woman that he will fight the bulls for her. In this marvelous adaptation, Shelley Hanson combines the march melody from this scene along with another melody from the opera in creating a well-balanced and appealing work for the concert stage.

Heard everywhere from concert halls to television commercials,  Hoe Down  is a classic American symphonic work and its unique sound has become a trademark of composer Aaron Copland. Trombone glissandos, Flex-a-tone, ratchet, flute head joint effects, ghostly howls, and so much more ensure that your beginners will love playing this comically scary arrangement. Feliz Navidad gets a complete makeover in this hip chart based on the Tom Scott arrangement. An infused Latin groove laced with tasty horn shouts provides the recipe for hip-holiday fun!! Your kids will love playing this chart by Tom Wallace.

Titles are: Star Wars® (Main Title) * Cantina Band * The Imperial March * Augie's Great Municipal Band * Across the Stars * and Battle of the Heroes. description: Kids love video games, so what better way to get them excited about playing music? This Robert Sheldon arrangement will be familiar to all your video-game-playing students. A symphonic sound is ensured with this classic video game overture-style theme. Video Games Live is an interactive experience that drew over 10,000 people to a concert at the Hollywood Bowl last year. Visit videogameslive.com for more information

Based on authentic Armenian folk songs collected by Komidas Vartabed, this work has been expanded through contemporary use of rhythmic, harmonic, and melodic content to showcase the modern wind band. A wonderful staple in wind literature. (12:00) This title is available in SmartMusic.

From its quiet opening through its grand and sweeping cascades of sound, this very familiar seasonal carol experiences a complete and powerful transformation. The use of brilliant metal percussion complements the massive peaks of sound from the winds. This scoring is guaranteed to leave your audiences breathless. The holiday concert closing selection. (3:19)

description: Arranged by Alfred Reed for Symphonic Band. This set includes full score and all individual parts.

Fortune and Glory is an evocative, exciting piece that will transport your audience into a swashbuckling action movie. Jack Wilds fills the piece with twists, turns, and jump cuts, making the music feel like a soundtrack that will ignite your students' imaginations. Positively energetic and highly approachable!

Journey through ethereal realms with Skyward Spirits, a symphonic masterpiece by JaRod Hall, who weaves tales of flight and fervor in this dynamic yet short micro-symphony. Begin with "Takeoff" as the brass fanfares and woodwind flourishes ignite the sky with anticipation. Drift into the embrace of "Under the Wing," a soulful reflection adorned with expansive melodies. Feel the tempestuous thrill of "Cloudburst," a

Close your program with this non-stop, energetic barnburner that combines elements of dance, jazz, and Latin grooves! As its title suggests, Rail Riffs feels like one massive party on rails that is certain to bring down the house. Brian Balmages pours on the coal, making this one ride you will not want to end!

Sentinel is a musical portrait of a lighthouse that conjures scenes of calm waters at sunrise, recreational boaters, beachgoers, and the powerful storms that come ashore. Opening fanfares give way to a carefree melody before an aggressive statement in low voices announces the storm's arrival. A dynamic work by Robert Sheldon.

Experience a dynamic oceanic adventure with this engaging work by Rossano Galante, who has composed the piece in a sea shanty style. A Ship in the Mist includes strong rhythmic elements that complement gorgeous lyrical writing, soaring themes, and lush harmonies. A fast, rhythmic transition brings the main theme back in grandiose fashion before a thrilling conclusion. Superb!

The Roaring Twenties by veteran arranger Carl Strommen features popular songs of the 1920s. The spirit of optimism is exemplified by upbeat tunes like "The Charleston," "Ja-Da," and "Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue," while the soulful ballad "My Melancholy Baby" provides a beautiful contrast. Your students will love learning about the music of this era and performing this swinging chart!
sous_titre: Featuring: The Charleston / Ja-Da / My Melancholy Baby / Five Foot Two

description: A beautiful setting of “Danny Boy” which will be a perfect change of pace on any concert program. Features a short trumpet or cornet solo and it’s an excellent tool for teaching your band the art of phrasing and legato style. Will be the hit of your next concert!

The movements are a romantic “Nocturne”, a gay, lilting “Scherzetto”, and a brilliant “Toccata” which is surprisingly set to a swing-boogie rhythmic background.

An attractive and effective arrangement of a delightful Rondo which can be played by Baritone Horn, Tuba, or F Horn with band accompaniment. Solo parts are grade 3 1/2 or 4 and while the band parts are not difficult notewise. Just the right length for concert use. Number three in the extremely popular Barnhouse Bach series. “Thus Do You Fare, My Jesus” by J.S. Bach is very lush and beautifully scored and this arrangement by Alfred Reed is simply beautiful.

This expressive piece is an excellent vehicle for teaching legato phrasing and lyrical style. The simple and reflective themes are pleasingly developed, which lead to a full ensemble climax, and fade with a warm and gentle ending. Perfect for that delicate, change-of-pace moment in your concert.

Jeff Steinberg's "Gospel John" was a great hit for Maynard Ferguson in the 1970's and still sounds totally hip. This new Andy Clark arrangement makes it playable with mid-level concert bands where it is sure to be a favorite with students and audiences alike! Ranges are reasonable and all the sections of your band get a chance to shine. A timeless classic that really rocks!

Audiences young and old alike will delight in this cultural work designed to feature the percussion section. Highlighted by authentic Cuban rhythms, this piece utilizes timbales, bongos, congas, claves, maracas and guiro. An infectious dance‐like melody is punctuated in the winds as the perfect compliment to the entire presentation. Sit back, relax and enjoy the "cool" sounds of "Mambo Cubano."

A unique Spanish March in the Paso Doble style that’s perfect for Middle School and Jr. High Bands. Includes optional parts for maracas, castanets and claves. Exceptional in every respect, this is a composition that your band will play for years to come. A REAL WINNER!

This work features several contrasting sections that are somewhat technically challenging, yet very playable. Additionally, the lovely middle theme is sure to enhance any band’s ability to handle the fundamentals of expressive playing.

You won't believe how many tunes Jerry Williams has worked into this fun medley, based around the popular Can-Can. Sousa, Wagner and William Tell all meet with many others in an arrangement that is sheer delight from start to finish. IRRESISTABLE!

description: Inspired by an Arabic folk song of the same name, the music describes a rainstorm followed by a harvest celebration. Opening with atmospheric sounds, the music slowly increases in intensity, accompanied by the compelling sounds of a thunder sheet. A powerful percussion section joins with brass to signal the storm’s arrival before the music erupts in dance and celebration.

Inspired by The Planets by Gustav Holst, this original piece pays homage to the first movement, Mars. Using only six notes in all instruments, the music still has a powerful quality that dares the listener to embrace the bold, majestic melodies and rhythmic ostinato. A unique original that invites further study of a master composer!

Finally – a delightful novelty piece that depicts every morning for every one of your students! Using just six notes and a wealth of dynamic contrasts, staccato style, and a variety of percussion timbres, this clever work portrays one person’s quest to get some sleep and the annoying alarm clock that just will not let it happen. Students and audiences will really enjoy this one!

This timeless Disney movie starring Julie Andrews and Dick Van Dyke remains as popular today as ever. With memorable tunes like Chim Chim Cher-ee, A Spoonful of Sugar, Feed the Birds and Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious, here is a medley that parents as well as students will enjoy and appreciate.
sous_titre: Music from the Motion Picture Soundtrack

description: Arranged in a driving dance groove and with interesting parts for all players, here is a great-sounding yet easy version of this popular Lady Gaga hit.

One of the landmark pop hits of the '80s, Like a Prayer was featured on the Glee episode The Power of Madonna. With a mix of rock and gospel styles, this powerful song is sure to be a favorite with your band and audience alike.
From the blockbuster film of 2009, here is a solid arrangement of the main themes for young players. Bold and adventurous!
Turn your percussion section loose on this rousing feature number originally from the '60s, but turned into a hit by the Sugarhill Gang in the '80s. Guaranteed fun!

Alfred Reed (1921-2005) was one of America's most prolific and frequently performed composers. The Hounds of Spring was composed in 1980 and was inspired by the poem Atalanta in Calydon by Algernon Charles Swinburne. In thisconcert overture, Reed captures the elements of youthful exuberance and tenderness of love expressed in the poem. Remaining true in form and intent to the original, Robert Longfield has

Originally scored for brass choir, composer John Stevens brings us this marvelous version for full band featuring flowing melodies and counterlines in a rich chorale-like setting. The solo part at the beginning and end is scored for euphonium, but is cued for clarinet, trumpet or trombone. Great for teaching a lyric style of playing, and also as an effective performance piece. Dur: 3:30

MusicWorks - Grade 2 This energetic work makes an impressive statement for young bands. Written in a single tempo throughout, you'll be amazed at the amount of excitement that can be generated with limited technical demands. Richard uses active percussion figures (augmented with optional additional mallet parts) along with powerful brass statements and layers of woodwind lines to create a wonderful overall effect.
John Williams' score from this movie sensation is filled with mystery and majesty along with a touch of whimsy. Here is a magnificent concert setting of the main themes. Performance time - ca. 5:00
Arranged from Johnnie Vinson.

Grease! is American pop culture at its best, now appealing to a whole new generation thanks to the reality TV series You're the One That I Want, and revival on Broadway. Includes the songs  We Go Together, Summer Nights, Greased Lightnin', Born to Hand Jive, and Beauty School Dropout.

Master composer Alfred Reed's newest work is yet another display of his skilled hand in the wind band medium.  He has selected four styles and used each in a short movement that captures a distinctive folk dance style.  The result has produced an exquisitely orchestrated and musically rewarding work for bands who demand high quality literature.  I.Hoe Down (American) II. Sarabande (French) III. Yamabushi Kagura

From the movie Somewhere in Time, John Barry's infectious theme has become a classic and is skillfully arranged in this setting for band. A haunting melody with rich sonorous chords and a beautiful orchestration give this selection a very unique quality.

The music of the '60s was just about as diverse as musically imaginable. And in the midst of it all, Motown continued to crank out hit after hit of catchy rhythm-based tunes. Here is a medley that is sure to be enjoyed by all agesthat includes: I Heard It Through the Grapevine, Land of a Thousand Dances, (You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman and Ain't No Mountain High Enough.
sous_titre: I Heard It Through the Grapevine - Land of a Thousand Dances - Natural Woman - Ain't No Mountain

Autrefois, Gorredijk était une ville florissante, un grand village vivifiant, situé au carrefour d’importantes routes de liaisons. Des sons inquiétants font allusions aux dangers des tourbières et des marécageux qui parcourent la région, tandis que résonne des rires et cris de joies :

Imagine yourself in a smoky pub with all the joys that entails. A nice jazzy solo puts you in the mood.  This Sugar blues dates from the thirties and is a classic in the jazz scene.  A wonderful solo in this case, a saxophone, but also for other instruments such as clarinet, trumpet or trombone (there are different transpositions of the solo part included).

Inspired by the wildly popular New Zealand sailing song this outstanding work takes us on an epic journey with the captain and the ship’s energetic crew. Moments of peril intertwine with chants of victory as the struggle unfolds. A superb change of pace for any concert, and a fantastic closer as well!

Set in a picturesque coastal Cornwall, in a tight-knit fishing village in the 1930s, Ladies in Lavender starred Judi Dench and Maggie Smith as sisters Ursula and Janet Widdington. A young Polish violinist from Krakow, Andrea, is swept overboard froma ship bound for America. When the sisters discover the handsome stranger on the beach below their house, they nurse him back to health. However, the presence of the

sous_titre: Concerning Hobbits / A Journey In The Dark / The Black Rider Many Meetings / Amon Hen

description: Ammerland brings you a vivid impression of this enchanting region by the Zwischenahner Lake (Germany)! The rural landscape of Ammerland combines fields covered with yellow rape blossoms, lush meadows, seemingly endless country roads and an exquisite lake. Let yourself be lured away on a short musical trip to beautiful Ammerland. Enjoy nature, the lake and the brilliant colours of a unique landscape.

Orion  est une marche lente qui se distingue par son caractère optimiste et sa fraîcheur. Cette marche de concert, techniquement peu exigeante, est accessible un grand nombre d’Orchestres d’Harmonie. Le choix de l’instrumentation permet également aux petites formations de l’interpréter avec un son d’ensemble tout aussi homogène. La pulsation rythmique presque continue de la percussion donne cette marche majestueuse

Le compositeur flamand Johan Nijs aime se laisser inspirer par des événements dans son environnement immédiat. En guise de cadeau de mariage, il dédia son épouse, la composition intitulée  Santa Pepita  tandis que son œuvre  Laurena  est dédiée sa fille. Les lignes mélodiques de cette œuvre possèdent un charme éthéré.

Toshio Mashima composed this work for the 40th anniversary of the concert band of the Kwansei-Gakuin University in Japan. The composition is based on the biblical story of the patriarch Jacob, who in a dream sees a ladder reaching into the sky. This story or its symbolism has inspired many artists - the rungs of the ladder representing the virtues through which man climbs during his lifetime.

Michael Jackson, the King of Pop, died in Los Angeles on June 25th 2009. He can without any shadow of a doubt be compared with artists such as Elvis Presley, Jimi Hendrix, and John Lennon - all of them musicians who will never die in the hearts of their fans. Why not keep the legend of Michael Jackson alive in your next concert with this hit from Michael Jackson’s repertoire arranged for Concert Band.

This hymn was commissioned by “Antwerpen 93”. And this city, on the banks of the river Schelde has been nominated “Cultural Capital of Europe” for 1993. The work-group “animatie” took the initiative and commissioned a hymn, which -as the finale to a grand open-air event on 27th March- was premièred by hundreds of musicians from all over Europe. This fabulous medley is composed of  Mickey Mouse March, It's a Small World, Heigh-Ho, Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Wolf, Someday My Prince Will Come, Whistle While You Work  and  When You Wish upon a Star .

Après des débuts difficiles en tant que musicien au sein de différents groupes, c’est la révélation et Billy enchaîne tube sur tube. Cette œuvre est basée sur l’histoire du film  Cinema Paradiso  où un soldat pauvre tombe amoureux d’une belle princesse. Il n’avait rien lui offrir mais il a réussi la rencontrer et lui déclarer son amour. Aimeriez-vous savoir ce qui s’est passé après… ?

Tout comme les splendides fleurs de magnolia qui s'épanouissent au printemps, cette simple mélodie chorale s'ouvre lentement, avec gr ce, avant de s'amplifier en une pleine floraison musicale. Puis le charmant théme initialrevient pour mener une douce conclusion, telle une fleur qui se referme la fin de la journée.

This unique work for advanced ensembles explores three fundamental minimalist approaches, but through the lens of very atypical styles to the minimalist genre. Influenced by the masterworks of Glass, Riley, and Adams, the composer uses a limited melodic/rhythmic palette to maximum effect, even including a rock-inspired shout section leading to a furious conclusion.

An impressive and dynamic fanfare styled concert piece which will provide a bold and stimulating opening to any performance. Steven Reineke’s writing always is full of energy and vitality and this composition will get your audience’s attention starting with the first note! Highly Spirited!
A folksetting composition that reflects on the beauty and history of the Blue Ridge Mountains of North Carolina. Excellent for Junior High/High School festival and contest performances.

Crimson, the deep and rich shade of red, is captured and eloquently displayed in this relentless composition. Chasing Crimson, an aggressive composition by Dakota Pederson, uses a traditional form and melody while incorporating creative harmonies with some dissonance. From measure one, audiences will be captivated by the memorable melody that showcases the power of a strong trombone section.

Join Roland Barrett on this multicultural musical journey depicting a nighttime celebration dancing around a roaring campfire. The work opens featuring a brief clarinet solo setting the stage and the bold dance commences. A real treat for your entire band is the relentless energy depicted by combining characteristic melodies with energetic hand clapping. A rousing choice! (3:05) This title is available in SmartMusic.

Some of the most popular Christmas selections of all time are included in this delightful arrangement, A Most Wonderful Christmas. Robert Sheldon has included "Winter Wonderland," "I'll Be Home for Christmas," "Santa Claus Is Comin' to Town," "Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas," and "It's the Most Wonderful Time of the Year" in this very tasteful setting for band. Solo opportunities abound and are cross-cued to

André Waignein a composé cette oeuvre pour saxophone alto et orchestre (ou piano) l’occasion de la cinquième édition du Concours International de Saxophone Adolphe Sax. Cette rhapsodie n’est pas une oeuvre programme, mais une oeuvre spontanée dont le développement se dessine naturellement. Le sens primitif du terme latin momentum est « ce qui est en mouvement ». Plusieurs équivalents français peuvent le remplacer selon le contexte : bref intervalle de temps (un instant), force, vigueur, vitesse ou quantité de mouvement, etc. Tandis que notre quotidien nous emporte dans une folle course contre la montre, Momentum nous offre un instant méditatif, une pause introspective.

Les années 1980 furent un véritable vivier de tubes mythiques qui ont laissé leur empreinte sur le paysage musical international. En 1985, le groupe pop-rock américano-britannique Katrina & The Waves (avec, sa tête, la chanteuse Katrina Leskanich), signe son premier succès mondial avec  Walking on Sunshine . Que le soleil brille sur vos concerts !
sous_titre: as performed by Katrina & the Waves

description: En mai 2006, le groupe californien Red Hot Chili Peppers publie son neuvième album studio  Stadium Arcadium  qui sera récompensé de quatre Grammy Awards. Une fois encore, les tubes funk-hard rock énergiques côtoient de jolies ballades plus tranquilles et mélodieuses telles que  Snow (Hey Oh) . Peter Kleine Schaars en a réalisé un arrangement fidèle la version originale.

description: L’auteur-compositeur américain Cole Porter (1891-1964) est initié au piano dès son plus jeune ge. Plus tard, il suit un cursus universitaire Yale puis Paris. Sa vie a suscité bien des commentaires. En 1918, il épouse Linda Lee Thomas. Le couple partage sa vie entre Paris, Venise, New York et Hollywood où Cole Porter se consacre la composition de musiques de films. Le mariage est heureux en dépit de l’homosexualité

collection: The Music of Johan de Meij
description: La Quintessenza is a musical approach of the quintessence, the heart of the matter. By focusing a five note motif in a number of variants, De Meij tries to get through to the essence of the musical matter. The core of the composition is a lyrical middle part (Arioso), preceded by an opening fanfare for brass (Introduzione) and a burlesque variant on the same motif (Capriccio). The African-American spiritual “Down in the River to Pray” forms the basis for this creative and dramatic work for mature ensembles. Opening with a tender chorale-like statement, the piece evolves throughout with variations in mood and intensity, ultimately building to a majestic and powerful conclusion. Dur: 5:20.
With a catchy melody and energetic style, every band will want to play this megahit hot off the charts. Easy ranges and rhythms help insure immediate success with this one.

Rivers have often served as a metaphor for life’s journey – starting in one place and traveling to somewhere unknown. This metaphor is depicted in a serene and contemplative work that uses a variety of colors and harmonies unique to young bands. Opulent mallet parts interact with optional piano to depict water gracefully cascading downwards. Gorgeous!

This great effects piece will transport your audience back to 1947, the year of the infamous Roswell Incident, when dozens of UFO sightings were reported over a large area of the western United States.

The slow introduction splits the melody between the clarinets, alto sax, and flute. This builds into a full band statement scored in a very lush manner. A faster section moves between 4/4 and 2/4, creating a pulse that captivatesthe listener. The repetitive rhythms and solid scoring of James Swearingen make this an ideal festival or contest piece.

The term Danceries can be found in a copy of Playford's Dancing Master which is an extensive collection of folk and popular tunes of the 17th Century (and no doubt earlier). The melodies themselves are a mixture of new and old(although where the old occurs, it has been adapted in mood and composition and is often interspersed with completely new material). En donnant de nouvelles couleurs sonores ± plusieurs cél¬bres chansons enfantines néerlandaises, Peter Kleine Schaars a réussi ± créer un medley tr¬s pimenté. Les rythmes endiablés des styles utilisés (house, swing, salsa, rock-shuffle et disco) mettront votre auditoire dans une ambiance de f¼te.

Pre-pop  s’inscrit dans la lignée d’ Inter-pop . Cette œuvre plaisante et divertissante, écrite quatre voix avec percussions, est parfaitement adaptée aux Orchestres Juniors. Une marche moderne, une ballade lente, une musique orientale, une valse lente et un boogie-woogie aux accents de swing constituent cette mosa que en cinq mouvements. Soyez créatifs !

Ponte Romano  est une œuvre de commande pour l’Orchestre d’Harmonie de Pont-Saint-Martin (Val d’Aoste). De l’immensité des montagnes environnantes se détache l’imposant pont romain du village. This fantastic medley will bring great joy to all those who remember these super hits. Some of your audience may like Bill Haley and some Michael Jackson, but they are all sure to sing-along when it comes to the Village People hit YMCA !

In the eighties the Pet Shop Boys produced hit after hit. It’s a Sin originates from the same year as their largest selling record West End Girls and this brave arrangement by Klauss van der Woude now means your concert band can enjoy the simplicity of this great pop song.

Ottorino Respighi (1879-1936) est considéré comme l'un des plus grands compositeurs italiens du début du XXe siècle. Respighi a composé plusieurs opéras, des ballets, quelques cantates, des œuvres de musique de chambre et des mélodies pour orgue et piano. Cette courte œuvre processionnelle convient parfaitement pour l’ouverture d’un concert, pour une intervention musicale dans le cadre d’une cérémonie ou en toute autre occasion solennelle. Le titre illustre la noble grandeur de l’établissement universitaire de la ville anglaise de Cambridge, où le grand apparat s’accorde avec le quotidien.

Chacune des vingt-quatre compositions - douze par livre - porte un titre évocateur. Lors de ses nombreux voyages travers le pays et plus particulièrement travers les campagnes du Norfolk, il recueille des chansons de tradition orale auprès de tous les corps de métiers. The third symphony was composed at a time when many composers were inspired by great patriotic feelings, and Zweers compositions were said to have been an influence on Dvorak, Smetana, Sibelius and Grieg. From the HBO mini-series, Jerry Brubaker has captured the essence of Michael Kamen's score in this diverse medley for Symphonic or Concert Band. From the lovely soaring ballads to the drivingly intense splashes of sound, it's allthere. Simply stunning! (5:13)

It is said that that unimaginable amounts of gold are hidden deep within the Fissserjoch in Tirol (in central Europe). Legend has it a giant made out of gold stands watch over it. Sometimes, late at night, mysterious lights can be seen and the sounds of treasure hunters drift into the valley. But at the break of dawn all is silent. Le style musical, directement inspiré de la musique baroque et associé des instruments modernes (batterie, guitare basse, synthé), séduit immédiatement. Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours  est un célèbre roman d'aventures de l’écrivain français Jules Verne, publié Paris en janvier 1873. L’histoire débute Londres. Philéas Fogg fait le pari de réussir le tour du monde en 80 jours seulement. L'exploit paraît impossible, mais la détermination de Fogg et de son domestique français Jean Passepartout est sans faille. Nous suivons en musique leurs pérégrinations

Né en 1934 en Autriche, Udo Jürgens compte parmi les plus grands auteurs-compositeurs et interprètes de la variété allemande. Il est un des rares artistes séduire des générations d’auditeurs et ce depuis des décennies. Auteur de plus de 900 chansons, il a vendu plus de 100 millions d’albums. Parmi ses plus grands succès, on compte  Ich war noch niemals in New York  dont Gilbert Tinner a réalisé un arrangement
titre: Ich war noch niemals in New York

Le sujet est exceptionnellement dramatique pour une comédie musicale de Broadway. L’intrigue se déroule sur fond de guerre, d’intolérance raciale, d’amours difficiles et de contrastes culturels. L’accompagnement reste discret pour mieux souligner la souplesse et les qualités techniques du soliste.Le second tableau, de caractère romantique, dévoile une mélodie fluide et sereine. La musique d’André Waignein privilégie la mélodie. Tel un peintre, il dessine des traits fluides et souples, où les arrondis donnent naissance des teintes chaleureuses.  Rêverie  est une œuvre poétique et rêveuse où s’expriment la délicatesse intime, l’élan romantique. La mélodie et l’accompagnement forment un ensemble fusionnel, serein, presque élégiaque.

Comme le suggère le titre, la musique nous invite porter un regard sur l’Est lointain, l’Orient. Le matériel thématique s’inspire d’éléments mélodiques et rythmiques caractéristiques de la musique orientale. Les trois parties pour saxophones se développent sur un accompagnement orchestral stylistiquement harmonieux. Le compositeur réussit exprimer efficacement une version de l’orientalité.

titre: La Fille Aux Cheveux De Lin

description: This great piece was composed by the award-winning Robert Jager. Among the the awards that Jager has won are the American Bandmasters Association Ostwald Award and the National School Orchestra Association Roth Award. This overture is in three sections. It starts and ends quickly, with a slower, more emotional middle section.

description: Commissioned by the Banda Sinfónica Infantil de Ch a, this work had its premiere in August 2015. It recalls the Dominican merengue in its "apambichao" variant, which is characterized by a more rhythmic nature and is well suited for beginner bands.Having a 2,5 degree of difficulty, it is a musical piece that livens up the spirits with its sound and joy.

description: Written in a grand film score style, this magnificent work opens with a dynamic fanfare featuring soaring brass and woodwind flourishes. Descriptive and evocative with every phrase, including a beautiful slow lyric section,transport your audience on a thrilling musical adventure with this impressive overture! Dur: 5:50 (Grade 5)

From Beethoven's Symphony No. 7, this movement is one of the master's most recognizable and performed themes. Recently featured in the Oscar-winning film The King's Speech, here is a skilled and effective adaptation for youngbands by Robert Longfield. A great way to showcase the classical period of musical history on any program. Dur: 2:45

Some of the most recognizable themes from film and television through the years have come from the creative genius of Henry Mancini. Here is a symphonic showstopper featuring outstanding settings of his biggest hits. Includes: ThePink Panther, Moon River, Baby Elephant Walk, Dreamsville, and Peter Gunn.

Released in 1993, this monumental Oscar-winning film from director Steven Spielberg ranks as one of the most highly-regarded movies of all time. The touching and poignant theme remains Mr. Spielberg's favorite of all of JohnWilliams' famous themes. This edition for band is an authentic transcription in the original key and features the violin solo as performed by Itzhak Perlman for the soundtrack. Performance time -

description: Written in a style similar to Michael's popular Celtic Air and Dance, here is another terrific setting of Celtic tunes arranged for very young bands. This arrangement opens with a beautiful and flowing version of the familiar airDanny Boy. From the king of swing, Sammy Nestico brings his inimitable symphonic jazz style to the concert stage. Originally written for the Boston Pops Orchestra, Sammy has re-worked this marvelous holiday setting for winds, featuring the classic carol Good King Wenceslas in a variety of jazz-flavored styles. The horn solos are cued and the piano part is optional. Sure to be a holiday favorite for years to come.

Commissioned by the Texas Music Educators Association for their 2005 All-State Band, Lux Aurumque is an extraordinarily lush and poignant adaptation of one of Eric Whitacre's most popular choral works. Gorgeous, simple triads melt from one beautiful chord to the next, creating a slowly evolving wash of colors and light. Elegantly orchestrated by the composer, Lux Aurumque is a profoundly moving experience for players

Continuing her amazing string of chart-topping hits, here is a solid arrangement of Lady Gaga's latest single to sweep the pop scene. With its driving style and '80s influence, this one adapts nicely for band.

Die Walküre (the Valkyries) is the second of the four works that make up the "Der Ring des Nibelungen" (The Ring of the Nibelung). It premiered in Munich in 1870. The "Ride of the Valkyries" is definitely the best-known piece from this opera andperhaps the most famous of all Wagners works. It was also used as the soundtrack during the helicopter attack in Francis Ford Coppolas film "Apocalypse Now".
